127:             "status": RunStatus.RUNNING,
128:         }
129: 
130:         try:
131:             final_state = await self.graph.ainvoke(
132:                 initial,
133:                 config={"recursion_limit": self._recursion_limit},
134:             )
135:         except LedgerFlowError as exc:
136:             # A defect that escaped the node boundary still deserves a
137:             # completed trace rather than a dangling one.
138:             self.runtime.trace(trace_id).event(
139:                 "execution_crashed", exc.to_dict()
140:             )
141:             return ExecutionResult(
142:                 run_id=run_id,
143:                 trace_id=trace_id,
144:                 thread_id=effective_thread,
145:                 mode=mode,
146:                 status=RunStatus.FAILED,
147:                 summary=exc.message,
148:                 intent=None,
149:                 skill_name=None,
150:                 skill_result=None,
151:                 errors=[AgentError(**exc.to_dict())],
152:             )
153:         except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - unexpected defects
154:             self.runtime.trace(trace_id).event(
155:                 "execution_crashed",
156:                 {"code": "unexpected_error", "message": str(exc)},
157:             )
158:             return ExecutionResult(
159:                 run_id=run_id,
160:                 trace_id=trace_id,
161:                 thread_id=effective_thread,
162:                 mode=mode,
163:                 status=RunStatus.FAILED,
164:                 summary=f"unexpected failure: {exc}",
165:                 intent=None,
166:                 skill_name=None,
167:                 skill_result=None,
168:                 errors=[
169:                     AgentError(
170:                         code="unexpected_error",
171:                         message=str(exc),
172:                     )
173:                 ],
174:             )
175: 
176:         # Persist the conversation as it stands after this turn (a failed
177:         # turn still records the question, without a fabricated reply).
178:         final_messages = final_state.get("messages") or []
179:         if effective_thread and final_messages:
180:             self._persist_thread(effective_thread, mode, final_messages)
181: 
182:         return self._to_result(run_id, trace_id, mode, effective_thread, final_state)
183: 
184:     def _load_messages(self, thread_id: str | None) -> list[Any]:
185:         if not thread_id:
186:             return []
187:         return self.runtime.thread_service.load(thread_id)
188: 
189:     @staticmethod
190:     def _to_result(
191:         run_id: str,
192:         trace_id: str,
193:         mode: AgentMode,
194:         thread_id: str | None,
195:         state: AgentState,
196:     ) -> ExecutionResult:
197:         return ExecutionResult(
198:             run_id=run_id,
199:             trace_id=trace_id,
200:             thread_id=thread_id,
201:             mode=mode,
202:             status=state.get("status", RunStatus.FAILED),
203:             summary=state.get("summary"),
204:             intent=state.get("intent"),
205:             skill_name=state.get("skill_name"),
206:             skill_result=state.get("skill_result"),
207:             tool_calls=list(state.get("tool_calls") or []),
208:             errors=list(state.get("errors") or []),
209:             warnings=list(state.get("warnings") or []),
210:         )

1: """Consolidation run persistence (filesystem, no database).
2: 
3: Each run is stored as one JSON file under ``storage/runs/<run_id>.json`` using
4: the existing atomic-write primitive, so a run survives a backend restart and
5: can be re-fetched by id. This is the minimum needed to support the
6: ``GET /api/consolidations/runs/{run_id}`` refresh path — no new persistence
7: system is introduced, and no PostgreSQL is required.
8: """
9: 
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: from datetime import datetime, timezone
13: from pathlib import Path
14: from typing import Any
15: 
16: from app.core.errors import NotFoundError, StorageError
17: from app.storage.filesystem import atomic_write_json, read_json
18: 
19: 
20: class ConsolidationRunStore:
21:     """Read/write consolidation run records on the filesystem."""
22: 
23:     def __init__(self, runs_dir: str | Path) -> None:
24:         self.runs_dir = Path(runs_dir)
25: 
26:     def _path(self, run_id: str) -> Path:
27:         if not run_id or "/" in run_id or "\\" in run_id or ".." in run_id:
28:             raise StorageError("invalid run id", details={"run_id": run_id})
29:         return self.runs_dir / f"{run_id}.json"
30: 
31:     def exists(self, run_id: str) -> bool:
32:         return self._path(run_id).is_file()
33: 
34:     def save(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
35:         """Persist a run record (``created_at`` set once, preserved on rewrite)."""
36:         run_id = str(record.get("run_id") or "")
37:         path = self._path(run_id)
38:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
39:         created_at = now
40:         if path.is_file():
41:             try:
42:                 created_at = read_json(path).get("created_at", now)
43:             except StorageError:
44:                 pass
45:         stored = {**record, "created_at": created_at, "updated_at": now}
46:         atomic_write_json(path, stored)
47:         return stored
48: 
49:     def load(self, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
50:         """Return a stored run, or raise ``NotFoundError``."""
51:         path = self._path(run_id)
52:         if not path.is_file():
53:             raise NotFoundError(
54:                 "consolidation run not found", details={"run_id": run_id}
55:             )
56:         data = read_json(path)
57:         if not isinstance(data, dict):
58:             raise StorageError(
59:                 "corrupt consolidation run record", details={"run_id": run_id}
60:             )
61:         return data

7: * a *proposal* references source rows and offers a candidate decision with a
8:   confidence score and explicit ``needs_human_review`` flag — it is never the
9:   posting itself;
10: * an *extracted fact* always carries its source file/section and a value that
11:   Python must cross-check against the source;
12: * an *investigation* explains and recommends, but cites the deterministic
13:   issue it is reasoning about and never overrides it.
14: 
15: Nothing here computes. The deterministic services remain the only source of
16: accounting numbers.
17: """
18: 
19: from __future__ import annotations
20: 
21: from enum import Enum
22: from typing import Any
23: 
24: from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
25: 
26: 
27: class Confidence(str, Enum):
28:     """A coarse, model-reported confidence band (never a financial value)."""
29: 
30:     LOW = "low"
31:     MEDIUM = "medium"
32:     HIGH = "high"
33: 
34: 
35: class EvidenceRef(BaseModel):
36:     """A pointer back to the exact source record a claim rests on."""
37: 
38:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
39: 
40:     source_file: str | None = None
41:     source_row: int | None = None
42:     section: str | None = None
43:     account_code: str | None = None
44:     note: str = ""
45: 
46: 
47: class ExtractedFact(BaseModel):
48:     """One accounting fact the LLM extracted from a source document.
49: 
50:     ``value`` is a *reference* the deterministic layer must verify against the
51:     source — the LLM never supplies an authoritative figure. ``needs_review``
52:     defaults to True so nothing extracted is trusted without confirmation.
53:     """
54: 
55:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
56: 
57:     fact: str
58:     value: str | None = None
59:     interpretation: str = ""
60:     evidence: EvidenceRef = Field(default_factory=EvidenceRef)
61:     confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW
62:     needs_review: bool = True
63: 
64: 
65: class PlanStep(BaseModel):
66:     """One step of an AI-proposed execution plan."""
67: 
68:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
69: 
70:     stage: str
71:     rationale: str = ""
72:     # Whether Python can execute this stage automatically today, or whether it
73:     # requires human approval / is blocked (mirrors the stage ledger).
74:     executable: bool = False
75:     requires_approval: bool = False
76: 
77: 
78: class ExecutionPlan(BaseModel):
79:     """The structured plan the LLM produces for a consolidation request.
80: 
81:     The plan names period, entities and presentation currency, lists the
82:     accounting stages, and separates auto-executable stages from those needing
83:     approval. It is advisory: the deterministic skill still decides what it
84:     can actually run.
85:     """
86: 
87:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
88: 
89:     period: str | None = None
90:     entities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
91:     presentation_currency: str | None = None
92:     workflow: str = "group_consolidation"
93:     summary: str = ""
94:     steps: list[PlanStep] = Field(default_factory=list)
95:     required_documents: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
96:     approval_stages: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
97:     confidence: Confidence = Confidence.MEDIUM
98:     source: str = "llm"
99: 
100: 
101: class MappingProposal(BaseModel):
102:     """An AI-assisted account-mapping recommendation (never auto-applied).
103: 
104:     Carries the recommended group account, the reasoning, the evidence (the
105:     real mapping row and COA entries it compared) and a confidence band. The
106:     deterministic mapper only adopts an approved proposal; an unapproved or
107:     low-confidence proposal is surfaced for human review.
108:     """
109: 
110:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
111: 
112:     entity: str
113:     local_code: str
114:     local_name: str | None = None
115:     current_group_code: str | None = None
116:     proposed_group_code: str | None = None
117:     proposed_group_name: str | None = None
118:     confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW
119:     reasoning: str = ""
120:     evidence: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
121:     needs_human_review: bool = True
122:     # Filled in by the deterministic layer: whether the proposal passed its
123:     # own checks (real COA account, name consistency, no material override).
124:     verified: bool = False
125:     verification_notes: str = ""
126: 
127: 
128: class AnomalyFinding(BaseModel):
129:     """One possible explanation for a validation anomaly (advisory only)."""
130: 
131:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
132: 
133:     issue_code: str
134:     entity: str | None = None
135:     account_code: str | None = None
136:     hypothesis: str = ""
137:     recommended_investigation: str = ""
138:     confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW
139:     evidence: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
140: 
141: 
142: class AnomalyInvestigation(BaseModel):
143:     """The LLM's advisory investigation of deterministic validation issues."""
144: 
145:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
146: 
147:     summary: str = ""
148:     findings: list[AnomalyFinding] = Field(default_factory=list)
149:     note: str = "Advisory only: deterministic validation results are preserved."
150: 
151: 
152: class MatchProposal(BaseModel):
153:     """The LLM's proposed intercompany match (never accepted on confidence alone).
154: 
155:     References two source rows by their 1-based row numbers in
156:     ``intercompany.csv`` and offers a confidence band and reasoning. Python
157:     independently verifies the proposal before it is treated as a match.
158:     """
159: 
160:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
161: 
162:     left_row: int = Field(ge=1)
163:     right_row: int = Field(ge=1)
164:     match_type: str = "reciprocal"
165:     confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW
166:     reasoning: str = ""
167:     proposed_difference_reason: str = ""
168: 
169:     @property
170:     def pair(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
171:         return (min(self.left_row, self.right_row), max(self.left_row, self.right_row))
172: 
173: 
174: class IntercompanyMatchingOutput(BaseModel):
175:     """The LLM's full response for an intercompany candidate-matching call."""
176: 
177:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
178: 
179:     proposals: list[MatchProposal] = Field(default_factory=list)
180:     unmatched_notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
181:     summary: str = ""
182: 
183: 
184: class AIStageReport(BaseModel):
185:     """The recorded outcome of one AI-assisted stage.
186: 
187:     ``status`` makes the AI availability explicit (``completed`` when it ran,
188:     ``not_configured`` when no key is present, ``failed`` when the LLM output
189:     could not be used). This is what the frontend renders as the AI stripe.
190:     """
191: 
192:     model_config = {"frozen": True}
193:

196:     detail: str = ""

313: /** Human labels for the AI-assisted stages. */
314: const AI_STAGE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
315:   ai_execution_plan: "AI execution planning",
316:   ai_account_mapping: "AI account-mapping investigation",
317:   ai_anomaly_investigation: "AI anomaly investigation",
318:   ai_intercompany_matching: "AI intercompany candidate matching",
319: };

321: /** Presentation metadata for an AI stage's explicit availability status. */
322: const AI_STAGE_META: Record<
323:   string,
324:   { label: string; badge: string; dot: string }
325: > = {
326:   completed: {
327:     label: "Ran",
328:     badge: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 ring-1 ring-violet-600/20",
329:     dot: "bg-violet-500",
330:   },
331:   not_configured: {
332:     label: "AI not configured",
333:     badge: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 ring-1 ring-slate-500/20",
334:     dot: "bg-slate-400",
335:   },
336:   failed: {
337:     label: "Failed",
338:     badge: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 ring-1 ring-rose-600/20",
339:     dot: "bg-rose-500",
340:   },
341:   skipped: {
342:     label: "Skipped",
343:     badge: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 ring-1 ring-slate-500/20",
344:     dot: "bg-slate-300",
345:   },
346: };
347: 
348: function aiStageLabel(stage: string): string {
349:   return AI_STAGE_LABELS[stage] ?? titleCase(stage);
350: }
351: 
352: /** Total latency and token usage across a stage's recorded LLM calls. */
353: function summarizeCalls(stage: AIStage): {
354:   calls: number;
355:   failed: number;
356:   latencyMs: number;
357:   tokens: number | null;
358: } {
359:   const calls = stage.call_records ?? [];
360:   const latencyMs = calls.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.latency_ms ?? 0), 0);
361:   const tokens = calls.reduce(
362:     (sum, c) => sum + (c.total_tokens ?? 0),
363:     calls.length > 0 ? 0 : 0,
364:   );
365:   return {
366:     calls: calls.length,
367:     failed: calls.filter((c) => !c.ok).length,
368:     latencyMs,
369:     tokens: tokens > 0 ? tokens : null,
370:   };
371: }
372: 
373: function AIStageRow({ stage }: { stage: AIStage }) {
374:   const meta = AI_STAGE_META[stage.status] ?? AI_STAGE_META.skipped;
375:   const summary = summarizeCalls(stage);
376:   return (
377:     <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 py-2.5">
378:       <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
379:         <span className={cn("mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", meta.dot)} />
380:         <div className="min-w-0">
381:           <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">
382:             {aiStageLabel(stage.stage)}
383:           </p>
384:           {stage.detail ? (
385:             <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
386:               {stage.detail}
387:             </p>
388:           ) : null}
389:           {summary.calls > 0 ? (
390:             <p className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">
391:               {summary.calls} LLM call{summary.calls === 1 ? "" : "s"}
392:               {summary.failed > 0 ? ` · ${summary.failed} failed` : ""}
393:               {summary.latencyMs > 0
394:                 ? ` · ${formatDuration(summary.latencyMs)}`
395:                 : ""}
396:               {summary.tokens ? ` · ${summary.tokens} tokens` : ""}
397:             </p>
398:           ) : null}
399:         </div>
400:       </div>
401:       <span
402:         className={cn(
403:           "inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-4xl px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
404:           meta.badge,
405:         )}
406:       >
407:         {meta.label}
408:       </span>
409:     </div>
410:   );
411: }

509: export function ConsolidationDashboard() {
510:   const [run, setRun] = useState<ConsolidationRun | null>(null);
511:   const [trace, setTrace] = useState<ConsolidationTrace | null>(null);
512:   const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
513:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
514: 
515:   const loadTrace = useCallback(async (runId: string) => {
516:     try {
517:       setTrace(await getConsolidationTrace(runId));
518:     } catch {
519:       setTrace(null);
520:     }
521:   }, []);
522: 
523:   const runConsolidation = useCallback(async () => {
524:     setRunning(true);
525:     setError(null);
526:     setTrace(null);
527:     try {
528:       const started = await startConsolidationRun();
529:       setRun(started);
530:       await loadTrace(started.run_id);
531:       // Reflect the run id in the URL so a refresh reloads the same run.
532:       const url = new URL(window.location.href);
533:       url.searchParams.set("run", started.run_id);
534:       window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.toString());
535:     } catch (err) {
536:       if (err instanceof ConsolidationApiError) {
537:         setError(err.message);
538:         if (err.body) {
539:           setRun(err.body);
540:           await loadTrace(err.body.run_id);
541:         }
542:       } else {
543:         setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Consolidation failed");
544:       }
545:     } finally {
546:       setRunning(false);
547:     }
548:   }, [loadTrace]);
549: 
550:   // Refresh path: if the URL carries a run id, load the persisted run.
551:   useEffect(() => {
552:     const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
553:     const runId = params.get("run");
554:     if (!runId) return;
555:     let cancelled = false;
556:     (async () => {
557:       try {
558:         const loaded = await getConsolidationRun(runId);
559:         if (cancelled) return;
560:         setRun(loaded);
561:         await loadTrace(runId);
562:       } catch {
563:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Run ${runId} could not be loaded`);
564:       }
565:     })();
566:     return () => {
567:       cancelled = true;
568:     };
569:   }, [loadTrace]);
570: 
571:   const readiness = run?.readiness ?? null;
572:   const entityOrder = ["US", "UK", "IN"];
573:   const entityKeys = readiness
574:     ? [
575:         ...entityOrder.filter((k) => k in readiness.entities_detail),
576:         ...Object.keys(readiness.entities_detail).filter(
577:           (k) => !entityOrder.includes(k),
578:         ),
579:       ]
580:     : [];
581: 
582:   return (
583:     <div className="space-y-6">
584:       {/* A. Header */}
585:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
586:         <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
587:           <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#0a1428] text-blue-400 ring-1 ring-slate-900/10">
588:             <BarChart3 className="size-5" aria-hidden />
589:           </span>
590:           <div>
591:             <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
592:               <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
593:                 Group Consolidation
594:               </h1>
595:               {run ? <RunStatusBadge status={run.status} /> : null}
596:             </div>
597:             <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
598:               Reporting period{" "}
599:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
600:                 {readiness ? `FY${readiness.period}` : "FY2024"}
601:               </span>{" "}
602:               · Presentation currency{" "}
603:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
604:                 {readiness?.functional_currency ?? "GBP"}
605:               </span>
606:             </p>
607:           </div>
608:         </div>
609:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
610:           <Button
611:             onClick={runConsolidation}
612:             disabled={running}
613:             aria-busy={running}
614:           >
615:             {running ? (
616:               <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
617:             ) : (
618:               <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden />
619:             )}
620:             {running ? "Running consolidation…" : "Run Consolidation"}
621:           </Button>
622:         </div>
623:       </div>
624: 
625:       {error ? (
626:         <div
627:           role="alert"
628:           className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700"
629:         >
630:           <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
631:           <span>{error}</span>
632:         </div>
633:       ) : null}
634: 
635:       {run ? (
636:         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
637:           <span>
638:             Run ID <code className="font-mono text-slate-700">{run.run_id}</code>
639:           </span>
640:           <span>
641:             Trace{" "}
642:             <code className="font-mono text-slate-700">{run.trace_id}</code>
643:           </span>
644:           <span>
645:             Started{" "}
646:             {run.created_at
647:               ? new Date(run.created_at).toLocaleString("en-GB")
648:               : "—"}
649:           </span>
650:         </div>
651:       ) : null}
652: 
653:       {/* B. Entity overview */}
654:       <Card>
655:         <CardHeader>
656:           <CardTitle>Entities</CardTitle>
657:           <CardDescription>
658:             Group entities with their functional currency and actual
659:             validation / mapping status from the backend run.
660:           </CardDescription>
661:         </CardHeader>
662:         <CardContent>
663:           {readiness && entityKeys.length > 0 ? (
664:             <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
665:               {entityKeys.map((key) => (
666:                 <EntityCard
667:                   key={key}
668:                   entity={readiness.entities_detail[key]}
669:                 />
670:               ))}
671:             </div>
672:           ) : (
673:             <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
674:               Run a consolidation to load entity statuses.
675:             </p>
676:           )}
677:         </CardContent>
678:       </Card>
679: 
680:       {/* C + D. Execution status and stage results */}
681:       <Card>
682:         <CardHeader>
683:           <CardTitle>Consolidation stages</CardTitle>
684:           <CardDescription>
685:             Each stage reflects what the backend actually executed. Blocked
686:             stages require accounting services that are not yet implemented.
687:           </CardDescription>
688:         </CardHeader>
689:         <CardContent>
690:           {running ? (
691:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-6 text-sm text-slate-500">
692:               <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
693:               Executing the shared agent…
694:             </div>
695:           ) : readiness ? (
696:             <>
697:               <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
698:                 {readiness.stages.map((stage) => (
699:                   <StageRow key={stage.stage} stage={stage} />
700:                 ))}
701:               </div>
702:               {!readiness.complete ? (
703:                 <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
704:                   Consolidation is not complete: {readiness.blocked_stages.length}{" "}
705:                   required stage
706:                   {readiness.blocked_stages.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} remain
707:                   blocked and {readiness.pending_stages.length} pending.
708:                 </p>
709:               ) : null}
710:             </>
711:           ) : (
712:             <p className="py-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
713:               No run yet. Use{" "}
714:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
715:                 Run Consolidation
716:               </span>{" "}
717:               to execute the FY2024 group consolidation.
718:             </p>

320:         except LedgerFlowError as exc:

351: async def match_intercompany(
352:     reasoner: LLMReasoner | None,
353:     reconciler: IntercompanyReconciler,
354:     records: list[IntercompanyRecord],

356:     """Propose intercompany matches (LLM) and verify them (Python)."""
357:     if reasoner is None:

359:             "ai_intercompany_matching", "no LLM configured; no proposals generated"
360:         )
361:     if not records:
362:         return None, AIStageReport(
363:             stage="ai_intercompany_matching",
364:             status="skipped",
365:             detail="no intercompany rows to match",
366:         )
367: 
368:     rows_text = "\n".join(_row_brief(r) for r in records)
369:     user = INTERCOMPANY_USER.format(
370:         rows=rows_text, reporting_currency=reconciler.reporting_currency
371:     )
372:     try:
373:         output = await reasoner.reason(
374:             template_id=INTERCOMPANY_TEMPLATE_ID,
375:             system_prompt=INTERCOMPANY_SYSTEM,
376:             user_prompt=user,
377:             schema=IntercompanyMatchingOutput,
378:         )
379:     except LedgerFlowError as exc:
380:         return None, _failed(
381:             "ai_intercompany_matching",
382:             f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}",
383:             [r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],
384:         )
385: 
386:     verified = verify_matches(
387:         reconciler,
388:         [p.model_dump() for p in output.proposals],
389:         records,
390:     )
391:     payload = {
392:         "summary": output.summary,
393:         "unmatched_notes": list(output.unmatched_notes),
394:         "proposals": verified,
395:         "accepted_count": sum(1 for v in verified if v["accepted"]),
396:         "proposed_count": len(verified),
397:     }
398:     return payload, AIStageReport(
399:         stage="ai_intercompany_matching",
400:         status="completed",
401:         detail=(
402:             f"{payload['accepted_count']}/{payload['proposed_count']} proposal(s) "
403:             f"verified as reconciling"
404:         ),
405:         call_records=[r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],

1: """Typed tool gateway: policy enforcement between skills and MCP tools.
2: 
3: The gateway is the only path from a skill to an MCP tool. It exists so
4: that an LLM can never widen what a skill is allowed to do: policy comes
5: from the skill's static :class:`SkillSpec` (registered and validated at
6: startup) and the execution mode — never from model output.
7: 
8: Enforced, in order, on every call:
9: 
10: 1. **budget** — per-execution call budget (``AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS``);
11:    once exhausted, further calls raise without recording.
12: 2. **policy** — ``ToolPolicy.NO_TOOLS`` rejects everything;
13:    otherwise the tool must be listed in the skill's ``permitted_tools``
14:    (an empty list permits nothing — fail closed).
15: 3. **read-only** — required when the skill's policy is
16:    ``READ_ONLY`` **or** the execution mode is ``copilot`` (defence in
17:    depth: even a mis-declared copilot skill cannot reach a mutating
18:    tool). Read-only status comes from the server's own
19:    ``ToolAnnotations.read_only_hint``; anything not explicitly marked
20:    read-only is treated as mutating.
21: 4. **dispatch** — only now does the call reach MCP.
22: 
23: Every attempt is recorded as a :class:`ToolCallRecord` (arguments
24: redacted) and emitted as a ``tool_call`` trace event, so policy
25: rejections and failures are as auditable as successes. Skills must not
26: re-add gateway records to their own ``SkillResult.tool_calls`` — the
27: graph merges them (duplicates are de-duplicated defensively).
28: """

102:         ``records`` (or the trace file) past the configured budget.

158:             )

162:             raise MCPError(

164:                 details={
165:                     "tool": name,

167:                     "available": sorted(await self._gateway.catalog()),
168:                 },
169:             )

193:         started: float,
194:         *,
195:         summary: str | None = None,

197:     ) -> None:

199:         record.ok = error is None
200:         record.result_summary = summary
201:         record.error = error

124:         return self.spec.permitted_tools
125: 
126:     def allows_mode(self, mode: AgentMode) -> bool:
127:         return mode in self.spec.allowed_modes
128: 
129:     def instructions_doc(self) -> str | None:
130:         """The skill's agent-facing ``SKILL.md`` description, if present.
131: 
132:         Loaded lazily and cached per instance, so an agent only ever receives
133:         the instructions of the skill that was actually selected — never
134:         another skill's. Returns ``None`` when the skill ships no document.
135:         """
136:         if getattr(self, "_instructions_doc", _UNSET) is _UNSET:
137:             from app.agents.skills.skill_instructions import (
138:                 SkillInstructionsNotFound,

144:             except SkillInstructionsNotFound:

146:         return self._instructions_doc

3: Loads the recorded rates from ``fx_rates.csv`` (via the existing

11:    ``1 / rate``. Justified because the source ``convention`` column states

13:    inverse quote (confirmed by policy review).

16:    where each leg is itself resolved direct-or-inverse. This implements the

18:    (for example, GBP/INR closing = GBP/USD closing x USD/INR closing)".

224:         if base == quote:

14: * **exchange differences** on translation go to the translation reserve
15:   (group account 3300), computed at the assembly stage from the translated
16:   asset/liability and profit-or-loss position.

185:         records: list[IntercompanyRecord] = []
186:         for index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
187:             entity = (row.get("reporting_entity") or "").strip().upper()
188:             counterparty = (row.get("counterparty") or "").strip().upper()
189:             # Validate the relationship deterministically; never invent one.
190:             for party in (entity, counterparty):
191:                 if party and party not in known:
192:                     raise UnknownEntityError(
193:                         f"intercompany row {index} references unknown entity {party!r}",
194:                         details={"source_row": index, "entity": party, "known": sorted(known)},
195:                     )
196:             records.append(
197:                 IntercompanyRecord(
198:                     source_row=index,
199:                     reporting_entity=entity,
200:                     counterparty=counterparty,
201:                     doc_ref=(row.get("doc_ref") or "").strip(),
202:                     doc_date=(row.get("doc_date") or "").strip(),
203:                     doc_currency=(row.get("doc_currency") or "").strip().upper(),
204:                     doc_amount=self._dec(row.get("doc_amount")),
205:                     booked_currency=(row.get("booked_currency") or "").strip().upper(),
206:                     booked_amount=self._dec(row.get("booked_amount")),
207:                     description=(row.get("description") or "").strip(),
208:                 )
209:             )
210:         return records
211: 
212:     def to_comparison_amount(
213:         self, record: IntercompanyRecord, *, rate_type: FXRateType = FXRateType.CLOSING
214:     ) -> Decimal:
215:         """Convert a record's booked amount to the reporting currency.
216: 
217:         Uses the approved :class:`FXService` (direct/inverse/cross) at full
218:         precision. Raises the typed ``MissingFXRateError`` when no rate exists —
219:         a rate is never fabricated.
220:         """
221:         if not self._fx:
222:             raise ServiceError("no FX service bound to the reconciler")
223:         if record.booked_currency == self.reporting_currency:
224:             return record.booked_amount
225:         return self._fx.convert(
226:             record.booked_amount,
227:             record.booked_currency,
228:             self.reporting_currency,
229:             rate_type,
230:         )
231: 
232:     # -- deterministic verification ---------------------------------------
233: 
234:     def verify(
235:         self,
236:         left: IntercompanyRecord,
237:         right: IntercompanyRecord,
238:         *,
239:         rate_type: FXRateType = FXRateType.CLOSING,
240:     ) -> MatchVerdict:
241:         """Verify whether ``left`` and ``right`` reconcile as a reciprocal pair.
242: 
243:         Checks, in order:
244: 
245:         1. **direction** — the pair must be reciprocal (A→B against B→A);
246:         2. **reference** — same ``doc_ref`` is required to call it a match; a
247:            differing reference is reported, never forced;
248:         3. **residual** — the reporting-currency difference is computed with
249:            Decimal and compared to the reporting quantum tolerance.
250: 
251:         Never accepts a match on the LLM's say-so: only the arithmetic decides.
252:         """
253:         if (
254:             left.reporting_entity != right.counterparty
255:             or right.reporting_entity != left.counterparty
256:         ):
257:             return MatchVerdict(
258:                 left_row=left.source_row,
259:                 right_row=right.source_row,
260:                 accepted=False,
261:                 match_type=MatchType.DIRECTION_INVALID,
262:                 residual=None,
263:                 reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
264:                 reason=(
265:                     f"rows {left.source_row} and {right.source_row} are not "
266:                     f"reciprocal ({left.reporting_entity}->{left.counterparty} vs "
267:                     f"{right.reporting_entity}->{right.counterparty})"
268:                 ),
269:             )
270: 
271:         if left.doc_ref and right.doc_ref and left.doc_ref != right.doc_ref:
272:             return MatchVerdict(
273:                 left_row=left.source_row,
274:                 right_row=right.source_row,
275:                 accepted=False,
276:                 match_type=MatchType.REFERENCE_MISMATCH,
277:                 residual=None,
278:                 reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
279:                 reason=(
280:                     f"references differ: {left.doc_ref!r} vs {right.doc_ref!r}"
281:                 ),
282:             )
283: 
284:         try:
285:             left_amt = self.to_comparison_amount(left, rate_type=rate_type)
286:             right_amt = self.to_comparison_amount(right, rate_type=rate_type)
287:         except Exception as exc:  # typed FX errors flow through
288:             return MatchVerdict(
289:                 left_row=left.source_row,
290:                 right_row=right.source_row,
291:                 accepted=False,
292:                 match_type=MatchType.RESIDUAL,
293:                 residual=None,
294:                 reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
295:                 reason=f"cannot convert to compare: {exc}",
296:             )
297: 
298:         residual = left_amt - right_amt
299:         if residual == _ZERO:
300:             return MatchVerdict(
301:                 left_row=left.source_row,
302:                 right_row=right.source_row,
303:                 accepted=True,
304:                 match_type=MatchType.EXACT,
305:                 residual=residual,
306:                 reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
307:                 reason=(
308:                     f"reciprocal rows reconcile exactly at {left_amt} "
309:                     f"{self.reporting_currency}"
310:                 ),
311:             )
312: 
313:         if abs(residual) <= self.tolerance:
314:             return MatchVerdict(
315:                 left_row=left.source_row,
316:                 right_row=right.source_row,
317:                 accepted=True,
318:                 match_type=MatchType.FX_RESIDUAL,
319:                 residual=residual,
320:                 reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
321:                 reason=(
322:                     f"reciprocal rows reconcile to within the reporting quantum "
323:                     f"(residual {residual})"
324:                 ),
325:             )
326: 
327:         return MatchVerdict(
328:             left_row=left.source_row,
329:             right_row=right.source_row,
330:             accepted=False,
331:             match_type=MatchType.RESIDUAL,
332:             residual=residual,
333:             reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
334:             reason=(
335:                 f"reciprocal rows differ by {residual} {self.reporting_currency} "
336:                 f"(beyond the {self.tolerance} tolerance)"
337:             ),
338:         )
339: 
340:     def verify_pair(
341:         self,
342:         left_row: int,
343:         right_row: int,
344:         records: list[IntercompanyRecord] | None = None,
345:         *,
346:         rate_type: FXRateType = FXRateType.CLOSING,
347:     ) -> MatchVerdict:
348:         """Verify a proposed pair by 1-based source row numbers.
349: 
350:         Raises ``ServiceError`` when a referenced row does not exist, so a
351:         proposal citing a fabricated row is rejected explicitly.
352:         """
353:         rows = records if records is not None else self.load_records()
354:         by_row = {r.source_row: r for r in rows}
355:         if left_row not in by_row or right_row not in by_row:
356:             raise ServiceError(
357:                 f"proposed match references unknown intercompany row(s) "
358:                 f"{left_row}, {right_row}",
359:                 details={
360:                     "left_row": left_row,
361:                     "right_row": right_row,
362:                     "available_rows": sorted(by_row),
363:                 },
364:             )
365:         return self.verify(by_row[left_row], by_row[right_row], rate_type=rate_type)
366: 
367:     # -- full reconciliation ----------------------------------------------
368: 
369:     def reconcile(
370:         self,
371:         records: list[IntercompanyRecord] | None = None,
372:         *,
373:         rate_type: FXRateType = FXRateType.CLOSING,
374:     ) -> ReconciliationResult:
375:         """Reconcile all intercompany rows into matched pairs and unmatched items.
376: 
377:         Rows are paired deterministically by ``doc_ref`` across reciprocal
378:         entities (A→B matched to B→A with the same reference). Each pair is
379:         verified by :meth:`verify`; a pair that verifies is retained with its
380:         closing-rate residual, which is what policy §5 sends to the FX account.
381: 
382:         A row with **no** reciprocal partner is never force-matched. When a
383:         one-sided row exists while the counterparty has already recorded an
384:         aggregate balance, it is classified ``in_transit`` (policy §5: "items
385:         in transit at the year end are recorded by the receiving entity at the
386:         closing rate"); otherwise it is left ``unmatched`` for human review.
387: 
388:         The distinction is deterministic: a one-sided row is ``in_transit``
389:         only when its reference does **not** appear on the counterparty side
390:         *and* the counterparty has at least one recorded row for this
391:         relationship — i.e. the relationship exists in both books but this
392:         particular document is missing on one side. Purely unmatched rows
393:         (no counterparty activity at all) stay ``unmatched``.
394:         """
395:         rows = records if records is not None else self.load_records()
396:         by_row = {r.source_row: r for r in rows}
397: 
398:         # Group the rows of one direction by reference: {(from, to): {ref: row}}.
399:         by_direction_ref: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, list[IntercompanyRecord]]] = {}
400:         for record in rows:
401:             if not record.doc_ref:
402:                 continue
403:             key = (record.reporting_entity, record.counterparty)
404:             by_direction_ref.setdefault(key, {}).setdefault(record.doc_ref, []).append(record)
405: 
406:         # Entities that appear on at least one side of a relationship.
407:         relationships: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
408:         for entity, counterparty in by_direction_ref:
409:             relationships.add((entity, counterparty))
410:             relationships.add((counterparty, entity))
411: 
412:         used: set[int] = set()
413:         pairs: list[ReconciledPair] = []
414: 
415:         for (entity, counterparty), refs in sorted(by_direction_ref.items()):
416:             if (entity, counterparty) not in relationships:
417:                 continue
418:             reverse = (counterparty, entity)
419:             for ref, left_rows in sorted(refs.items()):
420:                 for left in left_rows:
421:                     if left.source_row in used:
422:                         continue
423:                     candidates = [
424:                         r
425:                         for r in by_direction_ref.get(reverse, {}).get(ref, [])
426:                         if r.source_row not in used
427:                     ]
428:                     if not candidates:
429:                         continue
430:                     right = candidates[0]
431:                     verdict = self.verify(left, right, rate_type=rate_type)
432:                     used.add(left.source_row)
433:                     used.add(right.source_row)
434:                     left_gbp = self._to_gbp(left, rate_type) if verdict.residual is not None else None
435:                     right_gbp = self._to_gbp(right, rate_type) if verdict.residual is not None else None
436:                     pairs.append(
437:                         ReconciledPair(
438:                             doc_ref=ref,
439:                             doc_currency=left.doc_currency,
440:                             from_entity=left.reporting_entity,
441:                             to_entity=left.counterparty,
442:                             left_row=left.source_row,
443:                             right_row=right.source_row,
444:                             left_gbp=left_gbp if left_gbp is not None else _ZERO,
445:                             right_gbp=right_gbp if right_gbp is not None else _ZERO,
446:                             residual_gbp=verdict.residual if verdict.residual is not None else _ZERO,
447:                             match_type=verdict.match_type,
448:                             reason=verdict.reason,
449:                         )
450:                     )
451: 
452:         # Unmatched rows: classify in-transit vs genuinely unmatched.
453:         unmatched: list[UnmatchedItem] = []
454:         for record in rows:
455:             if record.source_row in used or not record.doc_ref:
456:                 continue
457:             reverse = (record.counterparty, record.reporting_entity)
458:             counterparty_active = reverse in by_direction_ref
459:             reverse_refs = by_direction_ref.get(reverse, {})
460:             same_ref_present = record.doc_ref in reverse_refs
461:             if counterparty_active and not same_ref_present:
462:                 classification = "in_transit"
463:                 reason = (
464:                     f"{record.reporting_entity} {record.doc_ref} has no "
465:                     f"counterpart row; the counterparty relationship exists but "
466:                     f"this document is missing — treated as an item in transit "
467:                     f"(policy §5)."
468:                 )
469:             else:
470:                 classification = "unmatched"
471:                 reason = (
472:                     f"{record.reporting_entity} {record.doc_ref} has no "
473:                     f"reciprocal counterparty row"
474:                 )
475:             gbp = self._to_gbp(record, rate_type)
476:             unmatched.append(
477:                 UnmatchedItem(
478:                     source_row=record.source_row,
479:                     reporting_entity=record.reporting_entity,
480:                     counterparty=record.counterparty,
481:                     doc_ref=record.doc_ref,
482:                     doc_currency=record.doc_currency,
483:                     doc_amount=record.doc_amount,
484:                     booked_currency=record.booked_currency,
485:                     booked_amount=record.booked_amount,
486:                     gbp_amount=gbp,
487:                     classification=classification,
488:                     reason=reason,
489:                 )
490:             )
491: 
492:         residual = sum((p.residual_gbp for p in pairs), _ZERO)
493:         return ReconciliationResult(
494:             reporting_currency=self.reporting_currency,
495:             pairs=tuple(pairs),
496:             unmatched=tuple(unmatched),
497:             residual_gbp=residual,
498:         )
499: 
500:     def _to_gbp(self, record: IntercompanyRecord, rate_type: FXRateType) -> Decimal | None:
501:         """GBP comparison amount for a record, or ``None`` if no rate exists."""
502:         try:
503:             return self.to_comparison_amount(record, rate_type=rate_type)
504:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - missing rate -> no fabricated figure
505:             return None
```

31: def round_reported(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:

248:     def map_trial_balance(self, tb: TrialBalance) -> MappedTrialBalance:

262:             # codes are left unresolved (reported, not guessed).
263:             by_local: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
264:             for entry in entries:
265:                 if entry.local_code and entry.group_code:
266:                     by_local[entry.local_code].add(entry.group_code)
267:             for local_code, group_codes in by_local.items():
268:                 if len(group_codes) == 1:
269:                     lookup[local_code] = next(iter(group_codes))

274:             lookup = {}

282:             group_account = self.group_coa.get(group_code) if group_code else None
283: 
284:             if entity not in _MAPPED_ENTITIES and group_code is not None and not mapped:
285:                 issues.append(
286:                     ValidationIssue(
287:                         code="missing_group_account",
288:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
289:                         message=(
290:                             f"{entity} account {row.local_account_code} is not "
291:                             f"in the group chart of accounts"
292:                         ),
293:                         entity=entity,
294:                         source_file=row.source_file,
295:                         source_row=row.source_row,
296:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,

298:                     )

309:                         ),

311:                         source_file=row.source_file,
312:                         source_row=row.source_row,
313:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,
314:                     )
315:                 )
316: 
317:             rows.append(
318:                 MappedRow(
319:                     entity=entity,
320:                     source_file=row.source_file,
321:                     source_row=row.source_row,
322:                     local_account_code=row.local_account_code,
323:                     group_account_code=group_code if mapped else None,
324:                     group_account_name=group_account.account_name if group_account else None,
325:                     currency=row.currency,
326:                     debit=row.debit,
327:                     credit=row.credit,
328:                     cost_centre=row.cost_centre,
329:                     mapped=mapped,
330:                     raw=row.raw,
331:                 )
332:             )
333: 
334:         return MappedTrialBalance(
335:             entity=entity,
336:             functional_currency=tb.functional_currency,
337:             source_file=tb.source_file,
338:             mapping_source_file=mapping_source_file,
339:             rows=rows,
340:             issues=issues,
341:         )
342: 
343:     @staticmethod
344:     def _resolve(
345:         entity: str, local_code: str, lookup: dict[str, str]
346:     ) -> str | None:
347:         if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES:
348:             return lookup.get(local_code)
349:         # US: identity, but only if the code is a real group account.
350:         return local_code or None

161:                 "source_row": row_no,
162:                 "column": "dr_cr",
163:                 "value": raw.get("dr_cr"),

167:         entity=entity,

169:         source_row=row_no,
170:         local_account_code=(raw.get("ledger_code") or "").strip(),
171:         account_name=(raw.get("ledger_name") or "").strip() or None,
172:         currency="INR",
173:         debit=debit,
174:         credit=credit,
175:         raw=dict(raw),
176:     )
177:

179: _ROW_PARSERS = {
180:     "US": _parse_us_row,
181:     "UK": _parse_uk_row,
182:     "IN": _parse_in_row,
183: }
184: 
185: 
186: class TrialBalanceIngestor:
187:     """Ingest one entity's trial balance from the immutable source dataset."""
188: 
189:     def __init__(self, service: SourceDataService | None = None) -> None:
190:         self.service = service if service is not None else SourceDataService()
191: 
192:     def ingest(self, entity: str) -> TrialBalance:
193:         """Return the normalised trial balance for ``entity``.
194: 
195:         Args:
196:             entity: ``US``, ``UK`` or ``IN`` (case-insensitive).
197: 
198:         Raises:
199:             UnknownEntityError: The entity id is not a known TB schema.
200:             UnknownSchemaError: The file's columns do not match the schema.
201:             InvalidNumberError: A numeric cell could not be parsed.
202:         """
203:         entity_id = (entity or "").strip().upper()
204:         if entity_id not in _SCHEMAS:
205:             raise UnknownEntityError(
206:                 f"no trial-balance schema for entity {entity!r}",
207:                 details={"requested": entity, "supported": sorted(_SCHEMAS)},
208:             )
209: 
210:         source = self.service.get_trial_balance(entity_id)
211:         source_file = str(source["source_file"])
212:         columns = [str(c) for c in source["columns"]]
213:         _require_schema(entity_id, source_file, columns)
214: 
215:         parser = _ROW_PARSERS[entity_id]
216:         rows: list[TrialBalanceRow] = []
217:         # Source row is 1-based excluding the header, so the first data line
218:         # is row 1 — matching what a human sees when counting file lines.
219:         for offset, raw in enumerate(source["rows"]):
220:             rows.append(parser(entity_id, source_file, offset + 1, {k: (v or "") for k, v in raw.items()}))
221: 
222:         meta = self._entity_meta(entity_id)
223:         return TrialBalance(
224:             entity=entity_id,
225:             legal_name=meta.get("legal_name") or None,
226:             functional_currency=meta.get("functional_currency") or "",
227:             source_file=source_file,
228:             rows=rows,
229:         )
230: 
231:     def _entity_meta(self, entity_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
232:         for row in self.service.list_entities():
233:             if row.get("entity_id", "").strip().upper() == entity_id:
234:                 return row
235:         return {}

1: # Northwind Group - accounting policies for consolidation (FY2024)
2: 
3: 1. **Presentation currency.** The group presents its consolidated statements in GBP.
4: 2. **Translation of entity statements into GBP.**
5:    - Assets and liabilities: closing rate at 31 December 2024.
6:    - Income and expenses: average rate for the period in which they are included in the group.
7:      For the US, the FY2024 average. For India, the H2 (1 July to 31 December 2024) average.
8:    - Equity: historical rates. Opening group equity is given in `prior_year_group.csv`.
9:    - Exchange differences on translation go to the translation reserve (account 3300).
10:    - Where a GBP rate is not given directly, use the product of the two given rates of the same type
11:      (for example, GBP/INR closing = GBP/USD closing x USD/INR closing).
12: 3. **Foreign currency items inside an entity's own books.** Monetary items in a currency other than the
13:    entity's functional currency are retranslated at the closing rate. Differences go to profit or loss
14:    (group account 7300).
15: 4. **Business combinations.** Non-controlling interest is measured at its proportionate share of net assets.
16:    Goodwill is held in the subsidiary's functional currency and retranslated at the closing rate.
17: 5. **Intercompany.** Intercompany balances, income and expenses are eliminated in full. Items in transit
18:    at the year end are recorded by the receiving entity at the closing rate. Any remaining exchange
19:    difference on eliminating intercompany income and expense goes to group account 7300.
20: 6. **Journals.** Manual journals are posted only if they are valid for FY2024. Invalid journals are not posted.
21: 7. **Rounding.** Translate at full precision and round each reported figure to 2 decimal places.

AI Agentic Engineer — Take-Home
Assignment (v2)
 Oct 21, 2026  ·  @Kush
1. Context
Design an agentic system that consolidates a multi-entity, multi-currency group and
produces its financial statements, and build a working version you can defend number by
number.
Plainflow builds AI-native financial reporting for mid-to-large enterprises. Our customers'
CFOs need statements they can sign, so every number must be right and every number
must trace back to source data.
The arithmetic is the easy part. The hard part is doing it reliably on messy real inputs:
different ERP export formats, mappings that are wrong, intercompany balances that don't
agree, currencies, minority owners, and data you cannot trust.
This pack contains deliberate traps, including text aimed at automated tools. Spotting
them is part of the evaluation. We have not listed the defects in the data.
2. Scenario and inputs
Northwind Group (fictional) has three entities and reports for the year ended 31
December 2024 in GBP, its presentation currency.
Item Detail
Time budget 10–12 hours of effort, over up to 7 calendar days
AI tools Encouraged. We also ask to see how you used them
(section 5)
Clarifying questions Email up to 3 before you start
Follow-up A 45-minute session where you run and defend
your submission

===== PAGE 3 =====
The agent topology you would use for the full product, and why.
Where you draw the line between deterministic code and LLM reasoning, and
where the AI actually earns its place.
How you handle failure modes: wrong mappings, data that doesn't balance,
intercompany disagreements, missing rates, untrusted text inside the data.
Your validation and self-correction loop: what is checked before output, and what
happens when a check fails.
How an auditor traces any figure on the statements back to source rows.
2. Working prototype in a Git repo. It consolidates the group end to end and writes the
outputs in section 4 to /output . Include a README with setup and run instructions.
Keep your full commit history; do not squash.
3. DECISIONS.md . Your 5 to 7 most important design decisions. For each: the options you
considered, what you chose, the trade-off, and what your AI tool suggested and
whether you took it.
4. VALIDATION.md . How you know your outputs are correct: the checks you coded,
figures you recomputed independently, and at least 3 things your AI tool got wrong,
each with the commit that fixed it.
5. AI tool transcripts. See section 5.
6. One-page reflection.
What you would build differently with 3 months instead of 12 hours.
Where your prototype would break at scale (thousands of accounts, dozens of
entities).
One thing about this problem you think we are underestimating.
4. Required outputs

If a figure cannot be determined from the inputs, write null  and give the reason. Never
estimate or fill in a value from outside the inputs. An honest null  scores better than a
confident guess.
5. Using AI tools
Use any AI tools you like; we want to see you use them well, so include the full, unedited
record of your sessions.
What to include: every session that contributed to the submission. For example,
Claude Code ( /export ), Cursor chat exports, or shared links for ChatGPT or Claude
conversations. Put them in a /transcripts  folder or link them from the README.
Redact secrets only. Remove API keys and personal data. Don't tidy up dead ends or
mistakes; they are often the most useful part.
What we look for: how you break the problem down, what you ask for, when you push
back, and how you check what the tool gives you. Using AI heavily is fine. Accepting its
output without checking is not.
You are responsible for every line and every number you submit, whoever or whatever
wrote it. In the follow-up session you will be asked to explain and change your own code.
6. How we evaluate
We care most about your judgment: what you noticed, what you checked, and what you
refused to guess.

What will hurt you
Figures that look right but can't be traced to source rows.
Any value invented to fill a gap in the inputs.
Output that can't be reproduced by running your repo.
An architecture that is "send the trial balance to a frontier model".
A 12-agent design for something a few hundred lines of code can do.
Not being able to explain your own code or numbers in the follow-up.
7. Submission and follow-up
Send one email with the repo link (public, or a private invite) and the architecture
document and reflection attached or committed to the repo.
If your submission passes review, we will invite you to a 45-minute session. You will clone
your repo fresh, run it, and walk us through your figures. We will also change an input and
ask what you expect to happen before you run it. Please have a working setup ready.
Appendix: conventions and control figures
All amounts in GBP, rounded to 2 decimal places. Round only the final figures, not
intermediate steps.
Follow group_policies.md . Where it is silent, choose, state your choice in
DECISIONS.md , and apply it consistently.
If part of a figure depends on an input that is missing, say in issues.json  how you
treated that part.
Name the control figures file control_figures_<your initials>.json , for example
control_figures_ab.json .
