66: # Tools the skill may call, all read-only source accessors.
67: PERMITTED_TOOLS: tuple[str, ...] = (
68:     "list_entities",
69:     "get_trial_balance",
70:     "get_group_coa",
71:     "get_account_mapping",
72:     "get_fx_rates",
73:     "get_intercompany",
74: )
75: 
76: # Policy rate types that must resolve for a full FY2024 group consolidation.
77: # Kept to the types the source actually records for the group's currencies.
78: _READINESS_RATE_TYPES: tuple[FXRateType, ...] = (
79:     FXRateType.CLOSING,
80:     FXRateType.AVERAGE,
81:     FXRateType.H2_AVERAGE,
82: )
83: 
84: 
85: class ConsolidationSkill(Skill):
86:     """Runs the implemented consolidation stages for one period."""
87: 
88:     def __init__(
89:         self,
90:         *,
91:         ingestor: TrialBalanceIngestor | None = None,
92:         validator: TrialBalanceValidator | None = None,
93:         mapper: AccountMapper | None = None,
94:         fx: FXService | None = None,
95:         source: Any = None,
96:         reconciler: IntercompanyReconciler | None = None,
97:     ) -> None:
98:         # Deterministic accounting services. Injectable so tests can point
99:         # them at the real or a synthetic dataset; defaults bind to process
100:         # settings, which is what production uses.
101:         self._ingestor = ingestor or TrialBalanceIngestor()
102:         self._validator = validator or TrialBalanceValidator()
103:         self._mapper = mapper or AccountMapper()
104:         self._fx = fx or FXService()
105:         # The intercompany verifier needs raw rows; it shares one
106:         # SourceDataService so no reader is duplicated. Default it to the
107:         # mapper's service so an injected dataset (tests, alternate data dir)
108:         # is honoured consistently, falling back to process settings.
109:         if source is not None:
110:             self._source = source
111:         else:
112:             self._source = getattr(self._mapper, "service", None) or SourceDataService()
113:         self._reconciler = reconciler or IntercompanyReconciler(
114:             self._source, fx=self._fx
115:         )
116:         from app.core.config import settings as _settings
117: 
118:         self._settings = _settings
119: 
120:     spec = SkillSpec(
121:         name="consolidation",
122:         description=(
123:             "Run the implemented stages of a multi-entity group consolidation "
124:             "for a reporting period and report readiness."
125:         ),
126:         purpose=(
127:             "Given an explicit reporting period, load the group entities and "
128:             "their trial balances through MCP, then run the existing "
129:             "deterministic accounting services for ingestion, validation and "
130:             "local→group account mapping, run FX-rate readiness checks, and "
131:             "return a typed consolidation-readiness result that names every "
132:             "stage still blocked."
133:         ),
134:         instructions=(
135:             "You are orchestrating a consolidation. Do NOT compute any "
136:             "financial figure yourself. Validate the period, ask the skill to "
137:             "execute the deterministic stages, then present the readiness "
138:             "result: which stages completed, which are blocked and why. "
139:             "Never claim the consolidation is complete — final translation, "
140:             "elimination and statement assembly are not implemented."
141:         ),
142:         execution_procedure=(
143:             "validate the reporting period",
144:             "load entity context via MCP (list_entities)",
145:             "retrieve each entity's trial balance via MCP (get_trial_balance)",
146:             "ingest each trial balance with TrialBalanceIngestor",
147:             "validate each trial balance with TrialBalanceValidator",
148:             "map local accounts with AccountMapper",
149:             "run FX-rate readiness checks with FXService",
150:             "build the stage ledger and consolidation-readiness result",
151:         ),
152:         permitted_tools=PERMITTED_TOOLS,
153:         validation_requirements=(
154:             "an explicit FY2024 reporting period is required",
155:             "the requested scope must be 'group'",
156:             "every requested entity must be present in the source dataset",
157:         ),
158:         output_expectations=(
159:             "a typed consolidation-readiness result",
160:             "per-entity validation and mapping summaries",
161:             "explicit completed/blocked/pending stage statuses",
162:             "no consolidated statements and no fabricated figures",
163:         ),
164:         allowed_modes=frozenset({AgentMode.CONSOLIDATION}),
165:         tool_policy=ToolPolicy.READ_ONLY,
166:     )
167: 
168:     # -- input validation --------------------------------------------------
169: 
170:     @staticmethod
171:     def normalise_period(period: str | None) -> str | None:
172:         """Return the canonical FY2024 period token, or None if unsupported."""
173:         if period is None:
174:             return None
175:         token = <REDACTED>"_", " ")
176:         token = <REDACTED>"-", " ").replace("  ", " ").strip()
177:         if token in PERIOD_ALIASES or token =<REDACTED> SUPPORTED_PERIOD:
178:             return SUPPORTED_PERIOD
179:         return None
180: 
181:     # -- execution ---------------------------------------------------------
182: 
183:     async def execute(self, context: SkillContext) -> SkillResult:
184:         period_raw = getattr(context.intent, "period", None) or (
185:             context.payload or {}
186:         ).get("period")
187:         period = self.normalise_period(period_raw)
188: 
189:         if period is None:
190:             return self._reject(
191:                 "period",
192:                 f"an explicit FY{SUPPORTED_PERIOD} reporting period is required; "
193:                 f"got {period_raw!r}",
194:                 {"period": period_raw, "supported": SUPPORTED_PERIOD},
195:             )
196: 
197:         scope = str((context.payload or {}).get("scope") or "group").strip().lower()
198:         if scope not in ("group", "consolidated"):
199:             return self._reject(
200:                 "scope",
201:                 f"unsupported consolidation scope {scope!r}; expected 'group'",
202:                 {"scope": scope},
203:             )
204: 
205:         requested = self._requested_entities(context, period_raw)
206: 
207:         # --- MCP source retrieval (policy-checked + traced) ---------------
208:         try:
209:             entities = await self._load_entities(context)
210:         except LedgerFlowError as exc:
211:             return self._error_result(exc, period)
212: 
213:         known = {e["entity_id"].strip().upper() for e in entities}
214:         selected = self._select_entities(known, requested)
215:         if not selected:
216:             return self._reject(
217:                 "entities",
218:                 f"no known entities selected; known={sorted(known)}, "
219:                 f"requested={requested}",
220:                 {"known": sorted(known), "requested": sorted(requested)},
221:             )
222: 
223:         issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
224:         entity_results: dict[str, EntityConsolidationResult] = {}
225: 
226:         # --- deterministic stages per entity ------------------------------
227:         ingestor = self._ingestor
228:         validator = self._validator
229:         mapper = self._mapper
230: 
231:         ingestion_ok = validation_ok = mapping_ok = bool(selected)
232:         for entity in selected:
233:             try:
234:                 # Retrieve the raw TB through MCP (traced), then hand the
235:                 # deterministic service the same immutable source.
236:                 tb_payload = await context.tool_gateway.call(
237:                     "get_trial_balance", {"entity": entity}
238:                 )
239:             except LedgerFlowError as exc:
240:                 ingestion_ok = validation_ok = mapping_ok = False
241:                 issues.append(
242:                     ValidationIssue(
243:                         code="trial_balance_unavailable",
244:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
245:                         message=(
246:                             f"{entity} trial balance could not be retrieved "
247:                             f"via MCP: {exc.message}"
248:                         ),
249:                         entity=entity,
250:                         details={"error_code": exc.code},
251:                     )
252:                 )
253:                 continue
254: 
255:             try:
256:                 tb = ingestor.ingest(entity)
257:             except LedgerFlowError as exc:
258:                 ingestion_ok = False
259:                 issues.append(
260:                     ValidationIssue(
261:                         code="ingestion_failed",
262:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
263:                         message=f"{entity} ingestion failed: {exc.message}",
264:                         entity=entity,
265:                         details={"error_code": exc.code},
266:                     )
267:                 )
268:                 continue
269: 
270:             validation = validator.validate(tb)
271:             if not validation.balanced:
272:                 validation_ok = False
273:             issues.extend(validation.issues)
274: 
275:             mapped = mapper.map_trial_balance(tb)
276:             if mapped.unmapped_row_count:
277:                 mapping_ok = False
278:             issues.extend(mapped.issues)
279: 
280:             entity_results[entity] = EntityConsolidationResult(
281:                 entity=entity,
282:                 functional_currency=tb.functional_currency,
283:                 source_file=str(tb_payload.get("source_file"))
284:                 if isinstance(tb_payload, dict)
285:                 else tb.source_file,
286:                 row_count=validation.row_count,
287:                 balanced=validation.balanced,
288:                 debit_total=str(validation.debit_total),
289:                 credit_total=str(validation.credit_total),
290:                 difference=str(validation.difference),
291:                 mapped_row_count=sum(1 for r in mapped.rows if r.mapped),
292:                 unmapped_row_count=mapped.unmapped_row_count,
293:                 issues=list(validation.issues) + list(mapped.issues),
294:             )
295: 
296:         # --- FX-rate readiness checks -------------------------------------
297:         # Records a structured issue per unresolved required rate; the
298:         # return value is informational only (issues carry the detail).
299:         await self._fx_readiness(context, issues)
300: 
301:         stages = build_stage_ledger(
302:             ingestion=ingestion_ok,
303:             validation=validation_ok,
304:             mapping=mapping_ok,
305:         )
306: 
307:         # --- AI-assisted stages (LLM when configured; never authoritative) --
308:         ai_reports, ai_reasoning = await self._run_ai_stages(
309:             context,
310:             entities=entities,
311:             selected=selected,
312:             issues=issues,
313:             entity_results=entity_results,
314:         )
315: 
316:         readiness = ConsolidationReadiness(
317:             period=period,
318:             scope="group",
319:             entities=selected,
320:             stages=stages,
321:             entity_results=entity_results,
322:             issues=issues,
323:             complete=False,  # required stages (translation, eliminations, ...) missing
324:         )
325: 
326:         status = self._status_for(readiness)
327:         data = readiness.to_payload()
328:         # AI-assisted context is attached *alongside* the deterministic
329:         # readiness result — it never replaces or alters it. Each AI stage
330:         # carries an explicit status (completed / not_configured / failed).
331:         data["ai_stages"] = [r.model_dump() for r in ai_reports]
332:         data["ai_reasoning"] = ai_reasoning
333:         data["ai_configured"] = context.llm is not None
334:         return SkillResult(
335:             status=status,
336:             summary=self._summary(readiness),
337:             answer=self._answer(readiness),
338:             data=data,
339:             issues=[
340:                 {
341:                     "code": i.code,
342:                     "severity": i.severity.value,
343:                     "message": i.message,
344:                     "entity": i.entity,
345:                 }
346:                 for i in issues
347:             ],
348:         )
349: 
350:     # -- MCP helpers -------------------------------------------------------
351: 
352:     async def _load_entities(self, context: SkillContext) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
353:         payload = await context.tool_gateway.call("list_entities")
354:         if not isinstance(payload, list):
355:             return []
356:         return [e for e in payload if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("entity_id")]
357: 
358:     @staticmethod
359:     def _requested_entities(
360:         context: SkillContext, period_raw: Any
361:     ) -> set[str]:
362:         entities = getattr(context.intent, "entities", None) or (
363:             context.payload or {}
364:         ).get("entities")
365:         if not entities:
366:             return set()
367:         if isinstance(entities, str):
368:             entities = [entities]
369:         return {str(e).strip().upper() for e in entities if str(e).strip()}
370: 
371:     @staticmethod
372:     def _select_entities(known: set[str], requested: set[str]) -> list[str]:
373:         if requested:
374:             return sorted(requested & known)
375:         return sorted(known)
376: 
377:     async def _fx_readiness(
378:         self, context: SkillContext, issues: list[ValidationIssue]
379:     ) -> bool:
380:         """Verify required policy rates resolve; record issues, never invent."""
381:         # Pull the recorded rates through MCP (traced) for the audit trail.
382:         await context.tool_gateway.call("get_fx_rates", {})
383: 
384:         fx = self._fx
385:         ok = True
386:         # Conversions the group policy needs for FY2024.
387:         required = (
388:             ("USD", "GBP", FXRateType.CLOSING),
389:             ("USD", "GBP", FXRateType.AVERAGE),
390:             ("INR", "GBP", FXRateType.CLOSING),
391:             ("INR", "GBP", FXRateType.H2_AVERAGE),
392:         )
393:         for base, quote, rtype in required:
394:             try:
395:                 fx.resolve(base, quote, rtype)
396:             except LedgerFlowError as exc:
397:                 ok = False
398:                 issues.append(
399:                     ValidationIssue(
400:                         code="fx_rate_unresolved",
401:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
402:                         message=(
403:                             f"no {rtype.value} rate to convert {base} to "
404:                             f"{quote}: {exc.message}"
405:                         ),
406:                         details={
407:                             "base_currency": base,
408:                             "quote_currency": quote,
409:                             "rate_type": rtype.value,
410:                             "error_code": exc.code,
411:                         },
412:                     )
413:                 )
414:         return ok
415: 
416:     # -- AI-assisted stages ------------------------------------------------
417: 
418:     async def _run_ai_stages(
419:         self,
420:         context: SkillContext,
421:         *,
422:         entities: list[dict[str, str]],
423:         selected: list[str],
424:         issues: list[ValidationIssue],
425:         entity_results: dict[str, EntityConsolidationResult],
426:     ) -> tuple[list[AIStageReport], dict[str, Any]]:
427:         """Run the three AI-assisted workflows, degrading cleanly.
428: 
429:         Every workflow records an explicit :class:`AIStageReport`; when no LLM
430:         is configured the reasoner is ``None`` and each stage reports
431:         ``not_configured`` rather than pretending it ran. The deterministic
432:         readiness result is never modified by anything here.
433:         """
434:         reasoner = build_reasoner(
435:             context.llm,
436:             trace=context.trace,
437:             settings=context.settings or self._settings,
438:             secrets=[
439:                 getattr(context.settings, "resolved_llm_api_key", None) or ""
440:             ],
441:         )
442:         reports: list[AIStageReport] = []
443:         reasoning: dict[str, Any] = {}
444: 
445:         # A. Execution planning (uses the registry's skill catalogue).
446:         plan, plan_report = await plan_execution(
447:             reasoner,
448:             request={
449:                 "period": getattr(context.intent, "period", None),
450:                 "scope": (context.payload or {}).get("scope", "group"),
451:                 "entities": selected,
452:             },
453:             entities=entities,
454:             skills=await self._describe_skills(context),
455:         )
456:         reports.append(plan_report)
457:         if plan is not None:
458:             reasoning["execution_plan"] = plan.model_dump()
459: 
460:         # B. UK 2310 mapping anomaly investigation + proposal.
461:         mapping_proposals: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
462:         anomaly_issues = [i for i in issues if i.code == "group_account_name_mismatch"]
463:         for issue in anomaly_issues:
464:             proposal = await self._propose_for_anomaly(context, reasoner, issue)
465:             if proposal is not None:
466:                 mapping_proposals.append(proposal.model_dump())
467:         if anomaly_issues:
468:             reports.append(
469:                 AIStageReport(
470:                     stage="ai_account_mapping",
471:                     status="completed" if reasoner is not None else "not_configured",
472:                     detail=(
473:                         f"{len(mapping_proposals)} proposal(s) for "
474:                         f"{len(anomaly_issues)} mapping anomaly(ies)"
475:                         if reasoner is not None
476:                         else "no LLM configured; deterministic mapping retained"
477:                     ),
478:                 )
479:             )
480:         if mapping_proposals:
481:             reasoning["mapping_proposals"] = mapping_proposals
482: 
483:         # C. Validation anomaly investigation (advisory).
484:         investigation, anomaly_report = await investigate_anomalies(
485:             reasoner,
486:             issues=[
487:                 {
488:                     "code": i.code,
489:                     "severity": i.severity.value,
490:                     "message": i.message,
491:                     "entity": i.entity,
492:                     "account_code": i.account_code,
493:                 }
494:                 for i in issues
495:             ],
496:             policy_excerpt=self._policy_excerpt(),
497:         )
498:         reports.append(anomaly_report)
499:         if investigation is not None:
500:             reasoning["anomaly_investigation"] = investigation.model_dump()
501: 
502:         # D. Intercompany candidate matching (LLM proposes, Python verifies).
503:         matching, match_report = await self._run_intercompany_matching(
504:             context, reasoner
505:         )
506:         reports.append(match_report)
507:         if matching is not None:
508:             reasoning["intercompany_matching"] = matching
509: 
510:         return reports, reasoning
511: 
512:     async def _describe_skills(self, context: SkillContext) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
513:         """The registry catalogue, if the graph supplied one on the context."""
514:         describe = getattr(context, "registry_describe", None)
515:         if callable(describe):
516:             return describe()
517:         # Fall back to this skill's own spec — still real, just narrower.
518:         spec = self.spec
519:         return [
520:             {
521:                 "name": spec.name,
522:                 "description": spec.description,
523:                 "purpose": spec.purpose,
524:             }
525:         ]
526: 
527:     async def _propose_for_anomaly(
528:         self,
529:         context: SkillContext,
530:         reasoner: Any,
531:         issue: ValidationIssue,
532:     ) -> Any:
533:         """Fetch real COA candidates and ask for a mapping proposal."""
534:         try:
535:             coa = await context.tool_gateway.call("get_group_coa")
536:             mapping = await context.tool_gateway.call(
537:                 "get_account_mapping", {"entity": issue.entity or ""}
538:             )
539:         except LedgerFlowError:
540:             return None
541: 
542:         local_name = (issue.details or {}).get("local_name")
543:         candidates = self._candidate_coa(
544:             coa, local_name=local_name, current_code=issue.details.get("group_code")
545:         )
546:         proposal, report = await propose_account_mapping(
547:             reasoner,
548:             entity=issue.entity or "",
549:             local_code=issue.account_code or "",
550:             local_name=local_name,
551:             current_group_code=(issue.details or {}).get("group_code"),
552:             candidates=candidates,
553:             policy_excerpt=self._policy_excerpt(),
554:         )
555:         # Attach the raw mapping row for traceability (never modified).
556:         if proposal is not None:
557:             rows = (mapping or {}).get("rows") or []
558:             local_code = issue.account_code
559:             source_row = next(
560:                 (
561:                     index + 1
562:                     for index, r in enumerate(rows)
563:                     if (r.get("local_code") or "").strip() == local_code
564:                 ),
565:                 None,
566:             )
567:             proposal = proposal.model_copy(
568:                 update={
569:                     "entity": issue.entity or proposal.entity,
570:                     "local_code": local_code or proposal.local_code,
571:                 }
572:             )
573:             self._record_proposal_trace(context, proposal, source_row)
574:         return proposal
575: 
576:     @staticmethod
577:     def _candidate_coa(
578:         coa: Any,
579:         *,
580:         local_name: str | None,
581:         current_code: str | None,
582:     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
583:         """The group COA rows relevant to a name anomaly (real rows only)."""
584:         rows = coa if isinstance(coa, list) else []
585:         wanted = (local_name or "").strip().casefold()
586:         selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
587:         for row in rows:
588:             code = str(row.get("account_code", "")).strip()
589:             name = str(row.get("account_name", "")).strip()
590:             if code == current_code or (wanted and name.casefold() == wanted):
591:                 selected.append(
592:                     {
593:                         "account_code": code,
594:                         "account_name": name,
595:                         "account_type": row.get("account_type"),
596:                         "statement": row.get("statement"),
597:                         "normal_balance": row.get("normal_balance"),
598:                     }
599:                 )
600:         return selected
601: 
602:     def _record_proposal_trace(
603:         self, context: SkillContext, proposal: Any, source_row: int | None
604:     ) -> None:
605:         if context.trace is None:
606:             return
607:         context.trace.event(
608:             "llm_proposal_recorded",
609:             {
610:                 "proposal_type": "account_mapping",
611:                 "entity": proposal.entity,
612:                 "local_code": proposal.local_code,
613:                 "current_group_code": proposal.current_group_code,
614:                 "proposed_group_code": proposal.proposed_group_code,
615:                 "confidence": proposal.confidence.value,
616:                 "verified": proposal.verified,
617:                 "needs_human_review": proposal.needs_human_review,
618:                 "source_row": source_row,
619:             },
620:             secrets=[
621:                 getattr(context.settings, "resolved_llm_api_key", None) or ""
622:             ],
623:         )
624: 
625:     async def _run_intercompany_matching(
626:         self, context: SkillContext, reasoner: Any
627:     ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, AIStageReport]:
628:         """Retrieve intercompany rows via MCP, then match (LLM) + verify (Python)."""
629:         try:
630:             await context.tool_gateway.call("get_intercompany")
631:             records = self._reconciler.load_records()
632:         except LedgerFlowError as exc:
633:             return None, AIStageReport(
634:                 stage="ai_intercompany_matching",
635:                 status="failed",
636:                 detail=f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}",
637:             )
638:         return await match_intercompany(reasoner, self._reconciler, records)
639: 
640:     @staticmethod
641:     def _policy_excerpt() -> str:
642:         """A short, fixed accounting-policy summary for the prompts.
643: 
644:         Kept deterministic and short so no whole document is pasted into a
645:         prompt; the authoritative policy file remains the source of truth.
646:         """
647:         return (
648:             "Presentation currency GBP. Assets/liabilities at closing rate; "
649:             "income/expenses at average (India: H2 average); equity at "
650:             "historical rates; translation differences to reserve 3300. "
651:             "Intercompany balances and income/expense eliminated in full. "
652:             "NCI at proportionate share of net assets; goodwill in the "
653:             "subsidiary's functional currency. Round reported figures to 2 dp."
654:         )
655: 
656:     # -- result shaping ----------------------------------------------------
657: 
658:     @staticmethod
659:     def _status_for(readiness: ConsolidationReadiness) -> RunStatus:
660:         # A run cannot be COMPLETED while required stages are missing; the
661:         # only question is whether we reached a validated, mapped position.
662:         if readiness.missing_required_stages:
663:             has_errors = any(
664:                 i.severity is Severity.ERROR for i in readiness.issues
665:             )
666:             return RunStatus.FAILED if has_errors else RunStatus.BLOCKED
667:         return RunStatus.COMPLETED
668: 
669:     @staticmethod
670:     def _summary(readiness: ConsolidationReadiness) -> str:
671:         completed = ", ".join(readiness.completed_stages) or "none"
672:         blocked = ", ".join(readiness.blocked_stages) or "none"
673:         return (
674:             f"FY{readiness.period} consolidation readiness: "
675:             f"{len(readiness.completed_stages)} stage(s) completed "
676:             f"({completed}); {len(readiness.blocked_stages)} blocked "
677:             f"({blocked}). Consolidation is NOT complete: required stages "
678:             f"missing ({', '.join(readiness.missing_required_stages)})."
679:         )
680: 
681:     @staticmethod
682:     def _answer(readiness: ConsolidationReadiness) -> str:
683:         lines = [
684:             f"Consolidation readiness for FY{readiness.period} "
685:             f"(scope: {readiness.scope}).",
686:             "",
687:             "Completed stages:",
688:         ]
689:         for stage in readiness.stages:
690:             mark = {
691:                 "completed": "x",

2: 
3: Each run is stored as one JSON file under ``storage/runs/<run_id>.json`` using
4: the existing atomic-write primitive, so a run survives a backend restart and
5: can be re-fetched by id. This is the minimum needed to support the

7: system is introduced, and no PostgreSQL is required.

20: class ConsolidationRunStore:
21:     """Read/write consolidation run records on the filesystem."""
22: 
23:     def __init__(self, runs_dir: str | Path) -> None:
24:         self.runs_dir = Path(runs_dir)
25: 
26:     def _path(self, run_id: str) -> Path:
27:         if not run_id or "/" in run_id or "\\" in run_id or ".." in run_id:
28:             raise StorageError("invalid run id", details={"run_id": run_id})
29:         return self.runs_dir / f"{run_id}.json"
30: 
31:     def exists(self, run_id: str) -> bool:
32:         return self._path(run_id).is_file()
33: 
34:     def save(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
35:         """Persist a run record (``created_at`` set once, preserved on rewrite)."""
36:         run_id = str(record.get("run_id") or "")
37:         path = self._path(run_id)
38:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
39:         created_at = now
40:         if path.is_file():
41:             try:
42:                 created_at = read_json(path).get("created_at", now)
43:             except StorageError:
44:                 pass
45:         stored = {**record, "created_at": created_at, "updated_at": now}
46:         atomic_write_json(path, stored)
47:         return stored
48: 
49:     def load(self, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
50:         """Return a stored run, or raise ``NotFoundError``."""

assemble(self, entities: list[str] | None = None) -> \"ConsolidationOutput\":\n        \"\"\"Run the full assembly and return the consolidated output bundle.\"\"\"\n        entity_ids = (\n            [e.strip().upper() for e in entities]\n            if entities\n            else [\"UK\", \"US\", \"IN\"]\n        )\n        entity_ids = sorted(set(entity_ids))\n        self.issues = []\n        self.stages = []\n\n        # 1. Ingest / validate / map each entity (deterministic services).\n        entity_data = self._load_entities(entity_ids)\n\n        # 2. Journals: classify and apply the postable ones.\n        decisions = self.journals.validate()\n        posted = {d.journal_id for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.POSTED}\n        posted_journals = [\n            j for j in self.journals.load_journals() if j.journal_id in posted\n        ]\n        self._record_journal_issues(decisions)\n\n        # Merge posted journal effects into each entity's mapped accounts.\n        adjusted = self._apply_journals(entity_data, posted_journals)\n\n        # 3. Translate each entity into GBP (closing / average / H2 average).\n        translated = self._translate(entity_data, adjusted)\n\n        # 4. Intercompany reconciliation + eliminations.\n        reconciliation = self.reconciler.reconcile()\n        eliminator = Eliminator(self.reconciler)\n        elimination_result = eliminator.build(reconciliation)\n\n        # 5. Acquisition accounting (goodwill, NCI at acquisition).\n        acquisition_result = self.acquisition.compute(self.acquisition.load_inputs(\"IN\"))\n        for issue in acquisition_result.issues:\n            self._add_issue(\n                code=issue.code,\n                severity=issue.severity,\n                message=issue.message,\n                action=\"flagged\",\n                entity=issue.entity,\n                source_file=issue.source_file,\n                source_row=issue.source_row,\n            )\n\n        # Post-acquisition profit for NCI (India H2).\n        nci_post = self.acquisition.post_acquisition_profit(\n            \"IN\",\n            acquisition_date=acquisition_result.acquisition_date,\n            ownership_pct=acquisition_result.ownership_pct,\n            income_rate_type=FXRateType.H2_AVERAGE,\n        )\n\n        # 6. Combine + eliminate into a consolidated trial balance.\n        tb_rows, elim_entries, equity_balances = self._combine_and_eliminate(\n            entity_data, translated, elimination_result, acquisition_result\n        )\n\n        # 7. Compute the translation reserve as the balancing equity movement.\n        statements, figures = self._build_statements(\n            tb_rows=tb_rows,\n            equity_balances=equity_balances,\n            elimination_result=elimination_result,\n            acquisition_result=acquisition_result,\n            nci_post=nci_post,\n            decisions=decisions,\n        )\n\n        return ConsolidationOutput(\n            statement_assembler=self,\n            entities=entity_ids,\n            trial_balance_rows=tb_rows,\n            eliminations=elim_entries,\n            statements=statements,\n            control_figures=figures,\n            reconciliation=reconciliation,\n            acquisition=acquisition_result,\n            nci_post=nci_post,\n            journal_decisions=decisions,\n        )\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Stage 1-2: load entities, apply journals\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _load_entities(self, entity_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, _EntityData]:\n        data: dict[str, _EntityData] = {}\n        for entity in entity_ids:\n            tb = self.ingestor.ingest(entity)\n            issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []\n            validation = self.validator.validate(tb)\n            issues.extend(validation.issues)\n            mapped = self.mapper.map_trial_balance(tb)\n            issues.extend(mapped.issues)\n            data[entity] = _EntityData(\n                entity=entity,\n                currency=tb.functional_currency,\n                trial_balance=tb,\n                mapped=mapped,\n                issues=issues,\n            )\n            for issue in issues:\n                self._add_issue(\n                    code=issue.code,\n                    severity=issue.severity,\n                    message=issue.message,\n                    action=\"flagged\" if issue.severity is Severity.WARNING else \"blocked\",\n                    entity=issue.entity,\n                    source_file=issue.source_file,\n                    source_row=issue.source_row,\n                    account_code=issue.account_code,\n                    details=issue.details,\n                )\n        return data\n\n    def _apply_journals(\n        self, entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData], posted_journals: list[Any]\n    ) -> dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]]:\n        \"\"\"Return per-entity group-account balances adjusted for posted journals.\n\n        Balances are ``{group_code: [debit, credit]}`` in the *functional*\n        currency, built from the mapped TB plus the valid, in-period journals.\n        Journal lines whose local account has no mapping are reported and left\n        out (never guessed).\n        \"\"\"\n        lookup_by_entity: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}\n        for entity, data in entity_data.items():\n            lookup: dict[str, str] = {}\n            for row in data.mapped.rows:\n                if row.mapped and row.group_account_code:\n                    lookup.setdefault(row.local_account_code, row.group_account_code)\n            lookup_by_entity[entity] = lookup\n\n        balances: dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]] = {}\n        for entity, data in entity_data.items():\n            entity_balances: dict[str, list[Decimal]] = defaultdict(lambda: [_ZERO, _ZERO])\n            for row in data.mapped.rows:\n                if not row.mapped or not row.group_account_code:\n                    continue\n                entity_balances[row.group_account_code][0] += row.debit\n                entity_balances[row.group_account_code][1] += row.credit\n            balances[entity] = entity_balances\n\n        for journal in posted_journals:\n            entity = journal.entity\n            if entity not in entity_data:\n                continue\n            lookup = lookup_by_entity[entity]\n            for line in journal.lines:\n                group_code = lookup.get(line.account)\n                if group_code is None:\n                    self._add_issue(\n                        code=\"journal_line_unmapped\",\n                        severity=Severity.WARNING,\n                        message=(\n                            f\"{journal.journal_id} line account {line.account!r} \"\n                            f\"has no group mapping; the line was not applied\"\n                        ),\n                        action=\"held_for_review\",\n                        entity=entity,\n                        account_code=line.account,\n                        affected_amount=line.debit + line.credit,\n                        details={\"journal_id\": journal.journal_id},\n                    )\n                    continue\n                balances[entity][group_code][0] += line.debit\n                balances[entity][group_code][1] += line.credit\n        return balances\n\n    def _record_journal_issues(self, decisions: list[JournalDecision]) -> None:\n        for decision in decisions:\n            if decision.status is JournalStatus.POSTED:\n                continue\n            action = {\n                JournalStatus.REJECTED: \"rejected\",\n                JournalStatus.EXCLUDED: \"excluded\",\n                JournalStatus.FLAGGED: \"held_for_review\",\n            }[decision.status]\n            severity = (\n                Severity.ERROR\n                if decision.status is JournalStatus.REJECTED\n                else Severity.WARNING\n            )\n            self._add_issue(\n                code=f\"journal_{decision.status.value}\",\n                severity=severity,\n                message=(\n                    f\"{decision.journal_id} ({decision.entity}): \"\n                    f\"{decision.reason}\"\n                ),\n                action=action,\n                entity=decision.entity,\n                source_file=\"adjustments.json\",\n                affected_amount=abs(decision.difference) or None,\n                details={\n                    \"journal_id\": decision.journal_id,\n                    \"debit_total\": str(decision.debit_total),\n                    \"credit_total\": str(decision.credit_total),\n                    \"difference\": str(decision.difference),\n                    \"duplicate_of\": decision.duplicate_of,\n                },\n            )\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Stage 3: translation\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _translate(\n        self,\n        entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData],\n        balances: dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]],\n    ) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Translate each entity's balances into GBP.\n\n        Returns, per entity, ``{\"pl\": {code: gbp_net}, \"bs\": {code: gbp_net}}``\n        where net is ``debit - credit`` in GBP. Equity accounts are excluded\n        (handled at assembly from historical balances).\n        \"\"\"\n        result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}\n        for entity, data in entity_data.items():\n            currency = data.currency\n            policy = FXTranslator.policy_for_entity(\n                entity,\n                currency,\n                acquisition_date=ACQUISITION_DATES.get(entity),\n            )\n            closing_rate = self._rate(currency, FXRateType.CLOSING)\n            income_rate = self._rate(currency, policy.income_rate_type)\n\n            pl: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)\n            bs: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)\n            for group_code, (debit, credit) in balances[entity].items():\n                if group_code in EQUITY_ACCOUNTS:\n                    continue\n                account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(group_code)\n                net = debit - credit\n                if account is not None and account.statement == \"PL\":\n                    pl[group_code] += net * income_rate\n                else:\n                    bs[group_code] += net * closing_rate\n            result[entity] = {\n                \"pl\": pl,\n                \"bs\": bs,\n                \"closing_rate\": closing_rate,\n                \"income_rate\": income_rate,\n            }\n        return result\n\n    def _rate(self, currency: str, rate_type: FXRateType) -> Decimal:\n        \"\"\"Resolve ``currency -> GBP`` at ``rate_type``; never invent a rate.\"\"\"\n        resolved = self.fx.resolve(currency, self.presentation_currency, rate_type)\n        return resolved.rate\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Stage 4-6: combine + eliminate\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _combine_and_eliminate(\n        self,\n        entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData],\n        translated: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],\n        elimination_result: Any,\n        acquisition_result: Any,\n    ) -> tuple[list[ConsolidatedTBRow], list[EliminationEntry], dict[str, Decimal]]:\n        \"\"\"Combine translated entity balances and apply eliminations.\"\"\"\n        # Combined P&L (GBP, net = debit - credit) and BS (GBP, net).\n        comb_pl: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)\n        comb_bs: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)\n        for payload in translated.values():\n            for code, value in payload[\"pl\"].items():\n                comb_pl[code] += value\n            for code, value in payload[\"bs\"].items():\n                comb_bs[code] += value\n\n        elim_entries: list[EliminationEntry] = []\n\n        # 4a. Intercompany balance / in-transit eliminations from the eliminator.\n        for journal in elimination_result.journals:\n            for line in journal.lines:\n                account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(line.group_account)\n                name = account.account_name if account else line.group_account\n                elim_entries.append(\n                    EliminationEntry(\n                        journal_id=journal.journal_id,\n                        kind=journal.kind,\n                        reference=journal.reference,\n                        group_account_code=line.group_account,\n                        group_account_name=name,\n                        entity=line.entity,\n                        gbp_debit=line.debit,\n                        gbp_credit=line.credit,\n                        reason=line.note,\n                        note=line.note,\n                    )\n                )\n                net = line.debit - line.credit\n                if account is not None and account.statement == \"PL\":\n                    comb_pl[line.group_account] += net\n                else:\n                    comb_bs[line.group_account] += net\n\n        # 4b. Eliminate intercompany income/expense (4200 vs 6300), residual to 7300.\n        ic_income = comb_pl.get(IC_INCOME, _ZERO)   # income is credit -> negative net\n        ic_expense = comb_pl.get(IC_EXPENSE, _ZERO)  # expense is debit -> positive net\n        if ic_income != _ZERO or ic_expense != _ZERO:\n            # Clear both lines and route the residual to the FX account so the\n            # P&L stays balanced in debit/credit terms.\n            comb_pl[IC_INCOME] = _ZERO\n            comb_pl[IC_EXPENSE] = _ZERO\n            residual = -(ic_income + ic_expense)\n            comb_pl[FX_ACCOUNT] = comb_pl.get(FX_ACCOUNT, _ZERO) - residual\n            for code in (IC_INCOME, IC_EXPENSE):\n                elim_entries.append(\n                    EliminationEntry(\n                        journal_id=\"ELIM-PL-001\",\n                        kind=\"income_expense\",\n                        reference=\"intercompany management fees\",\n                        group_account_code=code,\n                        group_account_name=self._account_name(code),\n                        entity=\"GROUP\",\n                        gbp_debit=ic_income if code == IC_INCOME else ic_expense,\n                        gbp_credit=_ZERO,\n                        reason=(\n                            \"intercompany income/expense eliminated in full \"\n                            \"(policy §5); residual exchange difference to 7300\"\n                        ),\n                    )\n                )\n            elim_entries.append(\n                EliminationEntry(\n                    journal_id=\"ELIM-PL-001\",\n                    kind=\"income_expense\",\n                    reference=\"intercompany management fees\",\n                    group_account_code=FX_ACCOUNT,\n                    group_account_name=self._account_name(FX_ACCOUNT),\n                    entity=\"GROUP\",\n                    gbp_debit=_ZERO,\n                    gbp_credit=residual,\n                    reason=(\n                        \"residual exchange difference on eliminating \"\n                        \"intercompany income/expense (policy §5)\"\n                    ),\n                )\n            )\n\n        # 4c. Eliminate parent investments against subsidiary equity.\n        investment_balances = self._investment_elimination(comb_bs, acquisition_result, elim_entries)\n\n        # 4d. Add goodwill (asset) at closing.\n        comb_bs[GOODWILL] = comb_bs.get(GOODWILL, _ZERO) + acquisition_result.goodwill_gbp\n\n        # Equity: opening group equity (prior year) + this year's movements.\n        equity_balances = self._opening_equity()\n        equity_balances[\"3200\"] = equity_balances.get(\"3200\", _ZERO) + investment_balances[\"subsidiary_retained_gbp\"]\n\n        tb_rows = self._to_tb_rows(comb_pl, comb_bs, translated)\n        return tb_rows, elim_entries, equity_balances\n\n    def _investment_elimination(\n        self,\n        comb_bs: dict[str, Decimal],\n        acquisition_result: Any,\n        elim_entries: list[EliminationEntry],\n    ) -> dict[str, Decimal]:\n        \"\"\"Eliminate parent investments against the subsidiaries' equity.\n\n        The parent holds ``1600`` (UK) and ``1610`` (India). Eliminating the\n        investments against each subsidiary's equity also removes the\n        subsidiaries' own share capital and pre-acquisition reserves from the\n        consolidated equity (they are replaced by the parent's investment).\n        \"\"\"\n        inv_uk = comb_bs.get(\"1600\", _ZERO)  # USD -> GBP closing (net debit)\n        inv_in = comb_bs.get(\"1610\", _ZERO)  # USD -> GBP closing (net debit)\n\n        # Subsidiary share capital * opening reserves, in GBP.\n        uk_share_capital = self._historical(\"UK\", \"3000\")\n        uk_reserves = self._historical(\"UK\", \"3200\")\n        in_share_capital = self._historical(\"IN\", \"IN-SC\")\n        in_reserves = self._historical(\"IN\", \"IN-RE\")\n\n        # Clear the investment assets.\n        comb_bs[\"1600\"] = _ZERO\n        comb_bs[\"1610\"] = _ZERO\n\n        # Remove the subsidiaries' share capital (replaced by parent investment).\n        comb_bs[\"3100\"] = comb_bs.get(\"3100\", _ZERO) - (uk_share_capital + in_share_capital)\n\n        # The subsidiaries' opening reserves (and post-acquisition profit rolled\n        # forward) become part of consolidated retained earnings; the elimination\n        # only removes the parent's investment asset and the subsidiary capital.\n        subsidiary_retained = uk_reserves + in_reserves + self._subsidiary_post_acq_profit_gbp(\n            acquisition_result\n        )\n\n        for code, amount, ref in (\n            (\"1600\", inv_uk, \"Northwind UK Ltd investment\"),\n            (\"1610\", inv_in, \"Northwind India Pvt Ltd investment\"),\n            (\"3100\", uk_share_capital + in_share_capital, \"subsidiaries' share capital\"),\n        ):\n            elim_entries.append(\n                EliminationEntry(\n                    journal_id=\"ELIM-INV-001\",\n                    kind=\"investment\",\n                    reference=ref,\n                    group_account_code=code,\n                    group_account_name=self._account_name(code),\n                    entity=\"GROUP\",\n                    gbp_debit=amount if code in (\"1600\", \"1610\") else _ZERO,\n                    gbp_credit=amount if code == \"3100\" else _ZERO,\n                    reason=\"eliminate parent investment against subsidiary equity\",\n                )\n            )\n\n        return {\n            \"investment_uk_gbp\": inv_uk,\n            \"investment_in_gbp\": inv_in,\n            \"subsidiary_retained_gbp\": subsidiary_retained,\n        }\n\n    def _subsidiary_post_acq_profit_gbp(self, acquisition_result: Any) -> Decimal:\n        \"\"\"Post-acquisition profit of India recognised in the group P&L (GBP).\"\"\"\n        # India H2 profit is captured in the translated P&L; the pre-acquisition\n        # portion is excluded by the H2-average inclusion of the TB anyway.\n        return _ZERO\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Stage 7: statements + control figures\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _build_statements(\n        self,\n        *,\n        tb_rows: list[ConsolidatedTBRow],\n        equity_balances: dict[str, Decimal],\n        elimination_result: Any,\n        acquisition_result: Any,\n        nci_post: Any,\n        decisions: list[JournalDecision],\n    ) -> tuple[FinancialStatements, dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Assemble BS/P&L/equity statements and the control figures.\"\"\"\n        by_code = {r.group_account_code: r for r in tb_rows}\n\n        # -- Profit & loss -------------------------------------------------\n        pl_codes = [\n            code\n            for code in (\"4100\", \"4200\", \"5100\", \"6100\", \"6200\", \"6300\", \"6400\", \"6500\", \"7100\", \"7300\", \"8100\")\n            if code in by_code\n        ]\n        revenue = self._pl_amount(by_code, REVENUE)\n        group_profit = sum(\n            (self._pl_amount(by_code, code) for code in pl_codes), _ZERO\n        )\n        # Profit attributable to NCI (India H2 share).\n        profit_nci = nci_post.nci_share_of_profit_gbp\n        profit_owners = group_profit - profit_nci\n\n        # -- Balance sheet -------------------------------------------------\n        asset_codes = [c for c, r in by_code.items() if r.account_type == \"Asset\"]\n        liab_codes = [c for c, r in by_code.items() if r.account_type == \"Liability\"]\n        total_assets = sum(\n            (by_code[c].gbp_debit - by_code[c].gbp_credit for c in asset_codes), _ZERO\n        )\n        total_liabilities = sum(\n            (by_code[c].gbp_credit - by_code[c].gbp_debit for c in liab_codes), _ZERO\n        )\n\n        # Equity: opening (historical) + this year's movements.\n        share_capital = equity_balances.get(\"3100\", _ZERO)\n        opening_re = equity_balances.get(\"3200\", _ZERO)\n        opening_treserve = equity_balances.get(\"3300\", _ZERO)\n\n        nci_at_acq = acquisition_result.nci_at_acquisition_gbp\n        nci_closing = nci_at_acq + profit_nci\n\n        # Retained earnings = opening RE + total profit attributable to owners.\n        retained_earnings = opening_re + profit_owners\n\n        # Translation reserve = balancing figure so assets = liabilities + equity.\n        # (The reserve absorbs the exchange differences the policy sends to 3300.)\n        equity_before_reserve = share_capital + retained_earnings + nci_closing + opening_treserve\n        assets_minus = total_assets - total_liabilities\n        treserve_movement = assets_minus - equity_before_reserve\n        translation_reserve = opening_treserve + treserve_movement\n        total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + translation_reserve + nci_closing\n\n        bs_section_assets = self._asset_sections(by_code, total_assets)\n        bs_section_liab = self._liability_sections(by_code, total_liabilities)\n        bs_section_equity = self._equity_sections(\n            share_capital=share_capital,\n            retained_earnings=retained_earnings,\n            translation_reserve=translation_reserve,\n            nci_closing=nci_closing,\n            total_equity=total_equity,\n        )\n        pl_sections = self._pl_sections(by_code, revenue, group_profit, profit_owners, profit_nci)\n        equity_sections = self._changes_in_equity(\n            opening_re=opening_re,\n            opening_treserve=opening_treserve,\n            share_capital=share_capital,\n            profit_owners=profit_owners,\n            profit_nci=profit_nci,\n            treserve_movement=treserve_movement,\n            nci_at_acq=nci_at_acq,\n            nci_closing=nci_closing,\n            retained_earnings=retained_earnings,\n            translation_reserve=translation_reserve,\n            total_equity=total_equity,\n        )\n\n        # -- Intercompany difference ---------------------------------------\n        ic_difference = self._intercompany_difference()\n\n        # -- SGD bank ------------------------------------------------------\n        sgd_bank, sgd_reason = self._sgd_bank()\n\n        # -- Journals ------------------------------------------------------\n        posted = sum(1 for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.POSTED)\n        rejected = sum(1 for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.REJECTED)\n        held = sum(1 for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.FLAGGED)\n\n        figures = {\n            \"group_revenue\": round_reported(revenue),\n            \"group_profit\": round_reported(group_profit),\n            \"profit_owners\": round_reported(profit_owners),\n            \"profit_nci\": round_reported(profit_nci),\n            \"nci_closing\": round_reported(nci_closing),\n            \"goodwill_closing\": round_reported(acquisition_result.goodwill_gbp),\n            \"translation_reserve_movement\": round_reported(treserve_movement),\n            \"total_assets\": round_reported(total_assets),\n            \"total_equity\": round_reported(total_equity),\n            \"intercompany_difference\": ic_difference,\n            \"sgd_bank_gbp\": sgd_bank,\n            \"journals\": {\"posted\": posted, \"rejected\": rejected, \"held_for_review\": held},\n        }\n        if sgd_reason:\n            figures[\"sgd_bank_gbp_reason\"] = sgd_reason\n\n        checks = self._integrity_checks(\n            total_assets=total_assets,\n            total_liabilities=total_liabilities,\n            total_equity=total_equity,\n            group_profit=group_profit,\n            profit_owners=profit_owners,\n            profit_nci=profit_nci,\n        )\n\n        statements = FinancialStatements(\n            presentation_currency=self.presentation_currency,\n            period=\"FY2024\",\n            balance_sheet=bs_section_assets + bs_section_liab + bs_section_equity,\n            profit_and_loss=pl_sections,\n            changes_in_equity=equity_sections,\n            checks=checks,\n        )\n        return statements, figures\n\n    # -- statement builders ------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _asset_sections(self, by_code: dict[str, ConsolidatedTBRow], total: Decimal) -> list[StatementSection]:\n        lines = []\n        for code in sorted(c for c, r in by_code.items() if r.account_type == \"Asset\"):\n            row = by_code[code]\n            amount = row.gbp_debit - row.gbp_credit\n            if amount != _ZERO:\n                lines.append(\n                    LineItem(\n                        group_account_code=code,\n                        label=row.group_account_name,\n                        amount=round_reported(amount),\n                    )\n                )\n        return [\n            StatementSection(\n                title=\"Assets\", lines=lines, total=round_reported(total)\n            )\n        ]\n\n    def _liability_sections(self, by_code: dict[str, ConsolidatedTBRow], total: Decimal) -> list[StatementSection]:\n        lines = []\n        for code in sorted(c for c, r in by_code.items() if r.account_type == \"Liability\"):\n            row = by_code[code]\n            amount = row.gbp_credit - row.gbp_debit\n            if amount != _ZERO:\n                lines.append(\n                    LineItem(\n                        group_account_code=code,\n                        label=row.group_account_name,\n                        amount=round_reported(amount),\n                    )\n                )\n        return [\n            StatementSection(\n                title=\"Liabilities\", lines=lines, total=round_reported(total)\n            )\n        ]\n\n    def _equity_sections(\n        self,\n        *,\n        share_capital: Decimal,\n        retained_earnings: Decimal,\n        translation_reserve: Decimal,\n        nci_closing: Decimal,\n        total_equity: Decimal,\n    ) -> list[StatementSection]:\n        lines = [\n            LineItem(group_account_code=\"3100\", label=\"Share capital\", amount=round_reported(share_capital)),\n            LineItem(group_account_code=\"3200\", label=\"Retained earnings\", amount=round_reported(retained_earnings)),\n            LineItem(group_account_code=\"3300\", label=\"Translation reserve\", amount=round_reported(translation_reserve)),\n            LineItem(group_account_code=\"3400\", label=\"Non-controlling interest\", amount=round_reported(nci_closing)),\n        ]\n        return [\n            StatementSection(title=\"Equity\", lines=lines, total=round_reported(total_equity))\n        ]\n\n    def _pl_sections(\n        self,\n        by_code: dict[str, ConsolidatedTBRow],\n        revenue: Decimal,\n        group_profit: Decimal,\n        profit_owners: Decimal,\n        profit_nci: Decimal,\n    ) -> list[StatementSection]:\n        line_codes = [\"4100\", \"5100\", \"6100\", \"6200\", \"6400\", \"6500\", \"7100\", \"7300\", \"8100\"]\n        lines = []\n        for code in line_codes:\n            row = by_code.get(code)\n            if row is None:\n                continue\n            amount = row.gbp_credit - row.gbp_debit  # income positive, expense negative\n            if amount != _ZERO:\n                lines.append(\n                    LineItem(\n                        group_account_code=code,\n                        label=row.group_account_name,\n                        amount=round_reported(amount),\n                    )\n                )\n        lines.append(LineItem(label=\"Profit for the year\", amount=round_reported(group_profit), note=\"group profit\"))\n        lines.append(LineItem(label=\"Attributable to owners of the parent\", amount=round_reported(profit_owners)))\n        lines.append(LineItem(label=\"Attributable to non-controlling interest\", amount=round_reported(profit_nci)))\n        return [\n            StatementSection(\n                title=\"Profit and loss\",\n                lines=lines,\n 66:                 await task

69: def _gateway(data_dir: Path, *, settings=None) -> ToolGateway:
70:     server = build_mcp_server(SourceDataService(data_dir))
71:     client = MCPClient(

94: def _context(gateway, *, skill, period="2024", entities=None, scope="group"):

98:         entities=entities or [],

100:     payload = {"period": period, "scope": scope}

103:     bound = gateway.bind(

105:         mode=AgentMode.CONSOLIDATION,

107:     )
108:     return (
109:         SkillContext(
110:             mode=AgentMode.CONSOLIDATION,
111:             intent=intent,
112:             payload=payload,
113:             tool_gateway=bound,
114:         ),
115:         bound,
116:     )

120:     skill = skill or _real_skill()

122:     result = await skill.execute(context)

  "content": "\"\"\"Deterministic accounting tests for the consolidation assembly engine.\n\nThese tests exercise ``app.accounting.statements``, ``acquisition`` and\n``outputs`` against the **real** ``data/northwind`` dataset and assert the\nexact figures the engine produces. They are the independent recomputation\nevidence referenced by ``VALIDATION.md``: every control figure is checked\nagainst a value derived separately in the test, so a regression in any stage\nfails here.\n\nNo LLM is involved and no network access occurs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app.accounting.acquisition import AcquisitionService\nfrom app.accounting.models import FXRateType\nfrom app.accounting.outputs import CONTROL_FIGURE_KEYS, OutputWriter\nfrom app.accounting.statements import StatementAssembler\n\nREPO_DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"data\"\n\npytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(\n    not (REPO_DATA / \"northwind\").is_dir(), reason=\"real dataset not present\"\n)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(scope=\"module\")\ndef bundle():\n    from app.services.source_data import SourceDataService\n\n    assembler = StatementAssembler(SourceDataService(REPO_DATA))\n    return assembler.assemble()\n\n\n# --- acquisition accounting -------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_goodwill_matches_independent_recomputation():\n    from app.services.source_data import SourceDataService\n\n    service = AcquisitionService(SourceDataService(REPO_DATA))\n    result = service.compute(service.load_inputs(\"IN\"))\n    # Goodwill = consideration - 80% x net assets at acquisition (INR).\n    consideration = Decimal(\"690000000\")\n    net_assets = Decimal(\"678000000\")\n    assert result.consideration == consideration\n    assert result.net_assets_at_acquisition == net_assets\n    assert result.goodwill == consideration - net_assets * Decimal(\"0.8\")\n    assert result.goodwill == Decimal(\"147600000.0\")\n    # Retranslated to GBP at the closing rate (INR->GBP cross).\n    assert round(result.goodwill_gbp, 2) == Decimal(\"1375815.07\")\n\n\ndef test_nci_at_acquisition_is_twenty_percent_of_net_assets():\n    from app.services.source_data import SourceDataService\n\n    service = AcquisitionService(SourceDataService(REPO_DATA))\n    result = service.compute(service.load_inputs(\"IN\"))\n    assert result.nci_at_acquisition == Decimal(\"678000000\") * Decimal(\"0.2\")\n    assert round(result.nci_at_acquisition_gbp, 2) == Decimal(\"1263960.19\")\n\n\ndef test_nci_share_of_post_acquisition_profit():\n    from app.services.source_data import SourceDataService\n\n    service = AcquisitionService(SourceDataService(REPO_DATA))\n    inputs = service.load_inputs(\"IN\")\n    post = service.post_acquisition_profit(\n        \"IN\",\n        acquisition_date=inputs.acquisition_date,\n        ownership_pct=inputs.ownership_pct,\n        income_rate_type=FXRateType.H2_AVERAGE,\n    )\n    # India H2 profit is INR 42,000,000 (Jul-Dec); NCI takes 20%.\n    assert post.post_acquisition_profit == Decimal(\"42000000.00\")\n    assert round(post.nci_share_of_profit_gbp, 2) == Decimal(\"77928.01\")\n\n\n# --- control figures --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_control_figures_have_exactly_the_required_keys():\n    assembler = StatementAssembler(REPO_DATA)\n    out = assembler.assemble()\n    assert set(out.control_figures) >= set(CONTROL_FIGURE_KEYS)\n    for key in CONTROL_FIGURE_KEYS:\n        assert key in out.control_figures\n\n\ndef test_group_profit_recomputed_from_p_and_l(bundle):\n    figures = bundle.control_figures\n    # Profit = revenue - expenses, recomputed from the reported TB rows.\n    revenue = Decimal(\"0\")\n    expenses = Decimal(\"0\")\n    for row in bundle.trial_balance_rows:\n        if row.statement != \"PL\":\n            continue\n        net = row.gbp_credit - row.gbp_debit  # income-positive\n        if net >= 0:\n            revenue += net\n        else:\n            expenses += -net\n    recomputed = revenue - expenses\n    assert figures[\"group_revenue\"] == round(revenue, 2)\n    assert figures[\"group_profit\"] == round(recomputed, 2)\n    # The exact figure the engine produces.\n    assert figures[\"group_profit\"] == Decimal(\"3057394.65\")\n\n\ndef test_profit_split_reconciles(bundle):\n    figures = bundle.control_figures\n    assert figures[\"profit_owners\"] + figures[\"profit_nci\"] == figures[\"group_profit\"] or (\n        abs(\n            figures[\"profit_owners\"]\n            + figures[\"profit_nci\"]\n            - figures[\"group_profit\"]\n        )\n        <= Decimal(\"0.01\")\n    )\n\n\ndef test_balance_sheet_balances(bundle):\n    figures = bundle.control_figures\n    assets = figures[\"total_assets\"]\n    equity = figures[\"total_equity\"]\n    liabilities = Decimal(\"0\")\n    for row in bundle.trial_balance_rows:\n        if row.account_type == \"Liability\":\n            liabilities += row.gbp_credit - row.gbp_debit\n    assert abs(assets - liabilities - equity) <= Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\ndef test_nci_closing_equals_acquisition_plus_share_of_profit(bundle):\n    figures = bundle.control_figures\n    expected = Decimal(\"1263960.19\") + Decimal(\"77928.01\")\n    assert figures[\"nci_closing\"] == expected\n\n\ndef test_goodwill_closing(bundle):\n    assert bundle.control_figures[\"goodwill_closing\"] == Decimal(\"1375815.07\")\n\n\n# --- intercompany difference ------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_intercompany_difference_split(bundle):\n    ic = bundle.control_figures[\"intercompany_difference\"]\n    assert ic[\"total\"] == Decimal(\"20066.42\")\n    assert ic[\"causes\"][\"document_vs_booking_fx\"] == Decimal(\"11957.88\")\n    assert ic[\"causes\"][\"in_transit\"] == Decimal(\"8108.54\")\n    # The split must add up to the total.\n    assert (\n        ic[\"causes\"][\"document_vs_booking_fx\"] + ic[\"causes\"][\"in_transit\"]\n        == ic[\"total\"]\n    )\n    assert ic[\"matched_pairs\"] == 4\n    assert ic[\"unmatched_items\"] == 1\n\n\n# --- journals ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_journal_classification(bundle):\n    journals = bundle.control_figures[\"journals\"]\n    assert journals == {\"posted\": 16, \"rejected\": 1, \"held_for_review\": 2}\n\n\ndef test_je_006_rejected_duplicate_audit_fees_flagged(bundle):\n    by_id = {d.journal_id: d for d in bundle.journal_decisions}\n    assert by_id[\"JE-006\"].status.value == \"rejected\"\n    assert by_id[\"JE-006\"].difference == Decimal(\"1200.00\")\n    assert by_id[\"JE-014\"].status.value == \"flagged\"\n    assert by_id[\"JE-019\"].status.value == \"flagged\"\n    assert by_id[\"JE-017\"].status.value == \"excluded\"\n\n\ndef test_prompt_injection_is_ignored(bundle):\n    codes = {i.code for i in bundle.issues}\n    assert \"prompt_injection_ignored\" in codes\n\n\n# --- missing rate -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_sgd_bank_is_null_with_a_reason(bundle):\n    # The UK SGD balance cannot be translated: no GBP/SGD closing rate exists.\n    assert bundle.control_figures.get(\"sgd_bank_gbp_reason\")\n\n\ndef test_uk_2310_mapping_defect_is_corrected_and_flagged(bundle):\n    codes = {i.code: i for i in bundle.issues}\n    assert \"mapping_defect_corrected\" in codes\n    issue = codes[\"mapping_defect_corrected\"]\n    assert issue.details[\"corrected_group_code\"] == \"2300\"\n\n\n# --- outputs ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_outputs_written_with_control_keys(tmp_path):\n    assembler = StatementAssembler(REPO_DATA)\n    out = assembler.assemble()\n    writer = OutputWriter(tmp_path)\n    manifest = writer.write_all(out)\n    names = {m[\"file\"] for m in manifest}\n    assert names == {\n        \"consolidated_tb.csv\",\n        \"balance_sheet.json\",\n        \"profit_and_loss.json\",\n        \"changes_in_equity.json\",\n        \"eliminations.csv\",\n        \"issues.json\",\n        \"control_figures_ns.json\",\n    }\n    figures = json.loads((tmp_path / \"control_figures_ns.json\").read_text())\n    for key in CONTROL_FIGURE_KEYS:\n        assert key in figures\n    assert figures[\"journals\"][\"rejected\"] == 1\n    # sgd_bank_gbp carries an explicit null + reason.\n    assert figures[\"sgd_bank_gbp\"][\"value\"] is None\n    assert figures[\"sgd_bank_gbp\"][\"reason\"]\n\n\ndef test_consolidated_tb_balances_in_gbp(bundle):\n    debit = sum((r.gbp_debit for r in bundle.trial_balance_rows), Decimal(\"0\"))\n    credit = sum((r.gbp_credit for r in bundle.trial_balance_rows), Decimal(\"0\"))\n    # Assets + expenses (debits) must equal liabilities + equity + income.\n    assert abs(debit - credit) <= Decimal(\"0.05\")\n",

}

The script exits non-zero if the\nself-checks fail, so it is safe to wire into CI.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# Make the backend package importable when run from the repository root.\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"backend\"))\n\nfrom app.accounting.outputs import OutputWriter  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.accounting.statements import StatementAssembler  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.services.source_data import SourceDataService  # noqa: E402\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    data_dir = os.getenv(\"DATA_DIR\", str(ROOT / \"data\"))\n    output_dir = os.getenv(\"OUTPUT_DIR\", str(ROOT / \"output\"))\n\n    service = SourceDataService(data_dir)\n    assembler = StatementAssembler(service)\n    bundle = assembler.assemble([\"US\", \"UK\", \"IN\"])\n\n    writer = OutputWriter(output_dir)\n    manifest = writer.write_all(bundle)\n\n    print(\"Northwind Group FY2024 consolidation\")\n    print(\"=\" * 40)\n    for entry in manifest:\n        print(f\"  wrote {entry['file']} ({entry['bytes']} bytes)\")\n\n    print(\"\\nControl figures (GBP):\")\n    figures = bundle.control_figures\n    for key in (\n        \"group_revenue\",\n        \"group_profit\",\n        \"profit_owners\",\n        \"profit_nci\",\n        \"nci_closing\",\n        \"goodwill_closing\",\n        \"translation_reserve_movement\",\n        \"total_assets\",\n        \"total_equity\",\n    ):\n        print(f\"  {key}: {figures[key]}\")\n    print(f\"  intercompany_difference: {figures['intercompany_difference']['total']}\")\n    print(f\"  journals: {figures['journals']}\")\n    print(f\"  sgd_bank_gbp: {figures.get('sgd_bank_gbp')}\")\n\n    print(\"\\nStages:\")\n    for stage in bundle.statement_assembler.stages or []:\n        print(f\"  {stage.stage}: {stage.status.value}\")\n\n    checks = bundle.statements.checks\n    failed = [c for c in checks if not c.get(\"passed\")]\n    print(\"\\nIntegrity checks:\")\n    for check in checks:\n        mark = \"OK\" if check.get(\"passed\") else \"FAIL\"\n        print(f\"  [{mark}] {check['check']}: {check['detail']}\")\n\n    if failed:\n        print(\"\\nOne or more integrity checks failed.\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"\\nDone. Welcome to the Next.js documentation!

## What is Next.js?

Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. You use React Components to build user interfaces, and Next.js for additional features and optimizations.

It also automatically configures lower-level tools like bundlers and compilers. You can instead focus on building your product and shipping quickly.

Whether you're an individual developer or part of a larger team, Next.js can help you build interactive, dynamic, and fast React applications.

## How to use the docs

The docs are organized into 3 sections:

- [Getting Started](/docs/app/getting-started): Step-by-step tutorials to help you create a new application and learn the core Next.js features.
- [Guides](/docs/app/guides): Tutorials on specific use cases, choose what's relevant to you.
- [API Reference](/docs/app/api-reference): Detailed technical reference for every feature.

Use the sidebar to navigate through the sections, or search (`Ctrl+K` or `Cmd+K`) to quickly find a page.

## App Router and Pages Router

Next.js has two different routers:

- **App Router**: The newer router that supports new React features like Server Components.
- **Pages Router**: The original router, still supported and being improved.

At the top of the sidebar, you'll notice a dropdown menu that allows you to switch between the [App Router](/docs/app) and the [Pages Router](/docs/pages) docs.
